economy.zh:
隔夜市场在三重力量下重定价：美伊谈判重启压制油价、美日罕见联合干预日元、全球AI抛售传导至中国科技股。政策面同时释放多重信号：中国核准核电、港交所推出国债期货、美联储密集推进银行规则改革。以下为过去24小时值得关注的经济要闻。

- 地缘溢价快速消退。特朗普称伊朗谈判将于周一恢复，并取消计划打击，WTI与布伦特双双跌逾5%，霍尔木兹海峡风险预期降温。但预测机构警告，若海峡持续关闭，英国将陷入衰退，显示供应链脆弱性仍高悬。[油价回落](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/08/03/oil-prices-today-wti-brent-hormuz-trump-iran.html) [英国衰退风险](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMirwFBVV95cUxPZThlOGd0bjBKTVNSUTZpVjRwZG5hWWZ0X1h0dDNBODRaZHktZEY5T1ZXbHZlYVZQcUNveGhGaXBjSEc4aDA5Ny1XUVR4a3JOc0lCbXdtdEZoTXVlQnQ2bjNpWFR6NGdZVDFpQU83X3dvaWNnSGdiYmNlLVJCRmxsRkt2aU9EN1FjczdfZUFTaElnb3MxSS1iYmswVVZqYW0wSGIwUFNINVZrVXUxckg4)

- 美日协调干预日元。日本财务省确认周五与美国财政部进行了买入日元的联合干预，并暗示必要时再出手。这是美方数十年来首度直接参与支撑日元，市场关注对套息交易与全球资本流动的连锁影响。[联合干预](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/08/03/yen-intervention-us-japan-trump-bessent-katayama.html)

- 并购潮再起。英国制药巨头阿斯利康与百时美施贵宝洽谈4000亿美元合并，若成行将是史上最大药企交易之一，反映行业寻求管线与规模对冲专利悬崖。[阿斯利康](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/08/02/astrazeneca-and-bristol-myers-squibb-mull-400-billion-deal-report-.html)

- 中国政策资金入场。全国社保基金今年前7个月增持A股，以真金白银表达对市场的信心；与此同时，全球AI抛售冲击芯片股，科创50一度跌逾5%，但阿里等因新AI模型逆势上涨。[社保基金](https://www.scmp.com/business/banking-finance/article/3362766/chinas-social-security-fund-boosts-stakes-share-firms-first-7-months-data-shows) [A股收评](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE51ZnVfU2RHMTFkb0d6TGRSdUV6SDJlQWNZNmNJTkM3UUc3S3F4Sl84OVU5eWRqRU9feEMzMF9EanRqN2FfbW53eWJZZm53MEdNV083Qm1YYlhXWkNUSmc)

- 中国资本市场开放加速。港交所周一正式推出五年期中国国债期货，为境外投资者提供对冲内地利率风险的新工具，国际机构兴趣浓厚；证监会同步推动扩大沪深港通范围。[国债期货](https://www.scmp.com/business/markets/article/3362586/global-institutional-investors-eager-trade-chinese-bond-futures-hong-kong-hkex-says)

- 中国产业政策发威。国务院核准8个新核电机组，核电全产业链概念集体爆发；但EV市场7月销量疲软，蔚来、小鹏、理想均环比下滑，市场担忧价格战重燃。[核电](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitgFBVV95cUxQQkJmc3FWZFd2dFg3YV9hM0s1NER3eDE0QlJLVEktdXNONFNFZU9vSVEzU05GbzF1VVBuZC1DWDZLSXVMczVfVnJyUS0tWkFwMlBuTFNnS25GdWZfTm41aU5SeDA4eFFZSWtBcGRoeXpHNTRYU0NjcEJTX1ozR1NtWmZaNm03VTNyTEtFTmFnb3N5MnZRQW9ERk1KYW5RNHpzVnFPTWkzY2ppbE1YMHA3aF9ZaU1Wdw) [EV销量](https://www.scmp.com/business/china-evs/article/3362717/price-war-fears-grip-chinas-ev-market-after-woeful-july-sales-figures)

- 欧洲经济冰火两重天。欧洲央行数据显示工资压力稳定（Q1 2027追踪指标2.7%），但年内野火损失已超30亿欧元，气候风险正成为财政新的负担。[ECB工资](https://www.ecb.europa.eu//press/pr/date/2026/html/ecb.pr260729~4ad7508d8a.en.html) [野火损失](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihAFBVV95cUxPRC1WREloXzdfVWprQlJQYzllTkprWTVCZklsVFhYcTl1LVFJaXk5bmFqdHZ3aFFSc0ROSGt3YTg0dE9ILTlwbUVNODR5MzR4aG5qbHB5TDBvUHkxR1lubHZrOXNocFpxUjNRWEdfakIxeVE5MXF2bmgzWlF0bUROZGdBZ1E)

**后续观察**：今日焦点将转向美伊谈判实质性进展、日元干预后亚洲时段汇率走势，以及中国AI板块能否在抛售后企稳。此外，阿斯利康并购若获证实，可能引爆医疗板块重估。油价下跌对通胀是好消息，但需警惕地缘反复。
economy.en:
Geopolitical risk is repricing: President Trump said Iran talks will resume Monday after planned strikes were called off, and oil prices fell more than 5% as investors cut Middle East premiums. In FX, the U.S. and Japan confirmed a rare coordinated yen-buying intervention. In equities, a blockbuster $400 billion pharma merger story emerged, while China saw an AI-led tech selloff despite broadening bullish participation. Europe’s data pulse looks stable, but wildfire costs and energy risks are mounting.

- **Oil and geopolitics**: WTI and Brent dropped over 5% after Trump called off strikes on Iran and said negotiators return Monday. A Reuters forecaster says the UK faces recession if the Strait of Hormuz stayed closed. [Oil drops over 5%](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/08/03/oil-prices-today-wti-brent-hormuz-trump-iran.html) | [Trump says Iran talks to resume](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/08/03/trump-iran-us-negotiations-peace-proposals-.html) | [UK faces recession warning](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMirwFBVV95cUxPZThlOGd0bjBKTVNSUTZpVjRwZG5hWWZ0X1h0dDNBODRaZHktZEY5T1ZXbHZlYVZQcUNveGhGaXBjSEc4aDA5Ny1XUVR4a3JOc0lCbXdtdEZoTXVlQnQ2bjNpWFR6NGdZVDFpQU83X3dvaWNnSGdiYmNlLVJCRmxsRkt2aU9EN1FjczdfZUFTaElnb3MxSS1iYmswVVZqYW0wSGIwUFNINVZrVXUxckg4)
- **Yen intervention**: Japan’s finance ministry confirmed it conducted a coordinated yen-buying intervention with the U.S. Treasury on Friday, and both sides signaled readiness to act again. The move ends decades of U.S. reluctance and raises the stakes for currency policy. [U.S., Japan confirm intervention](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/08/03/yen-intervention-us-japan-trump-bessent-katayama.html) | [Why the U.S. stepped in](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/08/03/japan-yen-intervention-us-treasurys-euros-.html) | [BBC on joint move](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cglj1pr0wjwo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)
- **Pharma megadeal watch**: AstraZeneca is in talks with Bristol Myers Squibb on a $400 billion merger, according to the FT. Confirmation would redraw the global pharmaceutical landscape and create major antitrust questions. [AstraZeneca in talks with BMS](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/08/02/astrazeneca-and-bristol-myers-squibb-mull-400-billion-deal-report-.html)
- **China’s two-speed market**: Global AI selling hit Chinese chipmakers and sent the STAR 50 down 5.08%, but more than 3,700 A-shares rose as nuclear, photovoltaic and AI application names gained; Alibaba rallied on a new AI model. [Global Market: China stocks slide](https://news.google.) | [Tonghuashun close: STAR 50 down 5.08%](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE51ZnVfU2RHMTFkb0d6TGRSdUV6SDJlQWNZNmNJTkM3UUc3S3F4Sl84OVU5eWRqRU9feEMzMF9EanRqN2FfbW53eWJZZm53MEdNV083Qm1YYlhXWkNUSmc)
- **Policy opening**: HKEX launched five-year China government bond futures, the first offshore Chinese government bond futures, and global investors are already signaling strong demand. CSRC is also pushing broader Stock Connect access. [HKEX says global investors eager](https://www.scmp.com/business/markets/article/3362586/global-institutional-investors-eager-trade-chinese-bond-futures-hong-kong-hkex-says) | [CSRC pushes broader Stock Connect](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMifkFVX3lxTFA1RXlzM2NZamVsbWpRX3VBaVdGSklPTEdsdm5tSHJSR1AtNWc3VDVEODdZQk9kTWR0SEM3QXNzRzN4S3U3Q21TY1NtQ2o2a3RJbEh5RWc1dDlBU2Q4Qy1pZlRsVU95bm1IUHFFQ2FnYmpWTXpNNC1NZldRNlJXdw)
- **China EV warning**: Xpeng, Nio and Li Auto all reported month-on-month sales declines in July, stoking fears of another brutal EV price war. [Price war fears grip China’s EV market](https://www.scmp.com/business/china-evs/article/3362717/price-war-fears-grip-chinas-ev-market-after-woeful-july-sales-figures)
- **Europe’s signals**: The ECB’s wage tracker came in at 2.7% for Q1 2027, suggesting stable negotiated wage pressure; European wildfire costs have already surpassed €3 billion; European equities were firmer premarket. society.en:
The last 24 hours show a coherent pattern: diplomatic frameworks are being announced, then immediately stress-tested by violence or official denial. In Gaza, a Hamas disarmament deal has not paused Israeli strikes; on Iran, Washington and Tehran are not even on the same page about whether talks exist; and in the Black Sea, Ukraine and Russia keep trading blows on energy and port infrastructure. Away from the conflict map, market intervention is moving currencies, young South Koreans are voting with their feet toward the Japanese labor market, and China's state media is using the summer window to push education and public-health narratives. On Zhihu, the community feed is fighting a spam invasion dressed as membership giveaways.

- Gaza ceasefire and disarmament are under strain: Israel said it killed at least 13 military operatives in strikes on Gaza City, Khan Younis and Deir el-Balah after Hamas agreed to a proposed disarmament deal; NPR reports at least 17 dead including children and cites Israel's 'serious concerns.' The pattern undercuts the idea that a deal is stabilizing the strip. ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/czjlvvkzj20o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss), [NPR](https://www.npr.org/2026/08/03/g-s1-136877/israel-serious-concerns-hamas-disarmament-deal-trump))
- Iran talks are disputed: Trump claimed negotiations will begin Monday, but Iran's foreign ministry says there are no current talks with the U.S.; Al Jazeera's live blog also notes Tehran urging Washington to honor a memorandum of understanding. This is a pre-negotiation rhetoric gap with real escalation risk. ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c23579jzv08o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss), [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2026/8/3/iran-war-live-trump-says-talks-set-to-begin-tehran-urges-us-to-honour-mou?traffic_source=rss))
- Ukraine and Russia are escalating an energy-infrastructure war: Ukraine says it hit a major Russian oil refinery and airfield, while Moscow reports eight deaths and says its military attacked Ukrainian ports and vessels in the Black Sea. Both sides are now targeting economic arteries, not just front lines. ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c998gg5pe09o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss))
- Dollar/yen intervention is unusually explicit: the dollar weakened sharply against the yen after President Trump and Japan's finance minister both confirmed market intervention. Rare joint confirmation by governments raises the stakes for future currency moves and matters for Asian exporters and global rate expectations. ([NPR](https://www.npr.org/2026/08/03/g-s1-136866/us-dollar-japanese-yen-market-interventions))
- East Asian labor flows are shifting: young South Koreans are increasingly searching for jobs in Japan as the domestic market disappoints—a story carried by Reuters, Asahi Shimbun and others—while Japanese firms are recruiting South Korean IT and AI talent. If sustained, this will reshape both countries' workforce debates. ([Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiwAFBVV95cUxQR1JWMkpuQ1gyX1lnRWpVWktLazExOWJ1UVlkUkFqSV9FOGxZNmFtVXA3TFRyVjBCM0tpdlRYbVp0WEl0VDlFMVhwSlVKX3J2S2NHdUlYd01BOE1WS3JaTTUzTHFhd2VZYW5RRzZ6VGVoX1ZHcmpWNjlXMTRoTDA2eVREZlVydlRSb3JPeV9pMGpYRXVuZ2t2Z3RfZlB6UUVFTFUzSjVQUFNoZlJiMVc4ZTI5Vll2WGpRT2hFUld5N3g), [Asahi](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE9nTkx2d0NtMUU1d1p3eHR5bVNSS1FNUS02SXlEVHh4cGxsVUVMVEQxQ3hTMDZXQ215d3luQ3M0SFI4UFVBdXFIdFNnaUFRV00xMkxhMzUtZFRNYVJFX1E), [Times of India](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi-))
- Zhihu's community feed is being spammed: multiple posts on TGBUS advertise gambling platforms as a way to get a free Zhihu Select annual card, and at least one 'leaked content' post is also circulating. Legitimate discussions—a Spider-Man ad using the Cape Verde goalkeeper and a property-fee legal case—are being crowded out by noise. ([TGBUS](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXEFVX3lxTE5PcGdJSnBHZnhuei1yNVE0TzYzT2Zudk5RaDJ2RHEyTTZqQkZMVnVFUFFvcVBvMWJPQzFHalBCNnZ1YzMxeXNMcjFiT0FtLTFfQk1Pc1ZWQVJjTVBC), [Colleges of Law](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMickFVX3lxTFBXZVg4UHBMR0pYQnpCZnVhTHlXVFNndXBIbGYyWFlMbFdFN3VPQzV3OHIxMko5VUdkQjJjZFc2eDV2TVpsMUNkSGxOVVRfaGFvekY4dTY1bW5iTlFFekdqSFNkazViR19OZTd1ekxfanVuQQ), [4A](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiX0FVX3lxTFAzdjdsSFBlUlcwNU1zODRZN1MtV2ZjLWV4QjB6eGNXTktPZmZnT3o4VFJYLVlzNFJKd1ZLTkk4My1lY1ZZMlI2Wlh1RWp3M3BCMzRxOGQtZVdHTWk1VEY0))
- China is sending state-signal stories: the education ministry is adding eight original textbooks in education and psychology, an official summer reading list is out, and a Chinese Ebola expert team has arrived in DR Congo. These are small but concrete indicators of education, welfare, and health-diplomacy priorities. ([Sohu](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiAFBVV95cUxPVWlDbVlYM3oxMVh2LTJTbU5FV1FwWHJmbVZGMlkyTHFvWkp1dDRwcURCWHA2aGZlUWxmNkQ1NWZMbUtKeEJoQ09peS16blFyZlh1OTg2MHBqTDNJZlFWUFZ3TWZJWFo0VmwtVUljY1JZLTk2aTBuNlc0ZVlOMUVfZjFQdnc0RXNZ), [Anhui Online](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMia0FVX3lxTE9STU9vbHpGNGphLTJiYnVwdXVmQ2tjUkpvbGR0MnQ2cWp3V1hyZVo5NjRVSGxhR0tRMk1Ndk9HYUJLTm5jWmtJR0k3dHlBZlp0RmJxMHR4QUJLSXVqTlF6dEJUVVNkRDk4TU93), [China.com](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMia0FVX3lxTE5lWkc1dk5ROXplZ0RablJTa1ZKVTZJQWNXXzVSa1hyeXFvNUlEMURPYjBCbWxrOHNEQ1hUNERLYXBXU3BIVWM4M01aZGpHWHFFWUZ3NFlUNVN5Z0JpNURieGM3YllNUTJ5YllF))

Watch next: whether Israeli strikes continue after the Hamas deal, whether Iran's 'no talks' position shifts before Monday, and whether the yen intervention holds. Also track whether South Korean jobseekers in Japan become a measurable trend—and whether Zhihu's feed gets cleaned of gambling spam.

- **俄海军双线动作**：俄加强黑海货船保护并探索新航线，同时[亚森-M级“乌里扬诺夫斯克”号下水](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/08/russia-floats-out-yasen-m-nuclear-submarine-ulyanovsk/)，维持水下核威慑更新节奏。
- **中国反介入展示**：中国海军公开052D驱逐舰发射YJ-20高超音速导弹，并在南海、黄岩岛举行演训，[航行警告](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMifEFVX3lxTE5ka0ZZSkNHTTNZTGQzTk1hblVoVklrSUhZRDZWcEtGQl8xMjY2R3Y5em4zaVV6X010aHdyVzBHOElRR2VoZFRzcF9aeUIxellTVFQ0OFR1b1A5YllfeTlGaE9aWjJQVUhsc3oyUF9NQ0FZZV9seVY4SnRnc0s)与演训形成组合信号。
- **俄乌战事焦灼**：俄军弹道导弹袭击基辅，乌无人机袭击俄炼油厂和机场；乌空军称累计击落91枚“匕首”和超6.5万架“沙赫德”。([Ukraine latest](https://news.google.)、[Air Force](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiwgFBVV95cUxOV0pCOXoxOVZzc2NXNzN6aVZIRjlOQ1JEX3NOVEQyalVUQjRNRFIyaS0wOFBuZmxXN2QxekhRWVVQaW9rVWdMVU5WQlJRYXZJMHphSVluUzAyQ1dyUjFLYUIwRmpva0FKS2VEZ1dzMThHbVk2eDdRNWM2d0pNSHVCSGtlM0NLYWQwWEdOTjdVWGNRWUJ0eXBYZzlDT0xVN0E4OEwwQ0M2dWR4ZGx4bm9PaFdOSmRFTzI3ZkxqWEFlQUhlZw))
- **欧洲与印太扩军**：波兰成立太空司令部，法国为核武Rafale准备新基地，日本海上自卫队首次实射“战斧”导弹。([Poland](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiwwFBVV95cUxPc0ZWWHJKVFhSNWF5VDZTMkYtTGYwbTVNb2Y2OW5Gbk5sZ3ppUWdlYl85al80cFUtbmxGMVY1bENfdGN5bExSU2M4RXkyWVBVeVZNWk8xalBJbFFFMjlvRjlPdk94Y0kxc3otRlQ1N044ZmpJNDZZU3JGU3ptWXpVbDhHcUpxbEswNUx1OXFZMGNiLVBpUTFjWTlSaE1pNmlNdzkxMzBfZ0dtS201cnA4dlBfTWRxQ0l4SW9EVm83YllpWkE)、[France](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMigwFBVV95cUxOaGJGTE54OTU1TXhwejZMaEhZVkFHTVdRc2s2VUpRbjE5QmJrbjV1UGc0WGNRdkRuM0t2bEZUaEdhWmlVUGpnTHJiMW5GYnpYSjNGMFl5SkJMV3ZBMjVoa1pQcTZZQkdVVkpwTmx2b3dnUnRWRnRVSW1Eck1WNFdSZmhRRQ)、[Japan](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMif0FVX3lxTE5jS3RsZEtOUjZ6aWZWdXJwLTRIeE1OVy1hUFJvNU4wdjFLYmV1Y19Hekt3cVQ2OUxKSHJ6RWVPM1lJa2luZkYycjF5a0Q2TnliUVNTMUl4NzlWTmozRjQxX0xsT0JhZmdGZG9sSlBUcGswcElwajg2OENVeGl5LTg))

**后续观察**：中东冲突的“降级”叙事很可能被新一轮空袭推翻，美伊博弈进入“边打边谈”阶段；俄中海军同步展示“反介入/区域拒止”能力，将在印太与欧洲同时牵动北约与盟友的军事部署。未来24小时需关注红海护航任务的进一步升级，以及中国南海演训是否引发域外国家反应。
military.en:
Over the past 24 hours, military reporting has shifted from single-front crises to a system under compound pressure: the Middle East war is widening, the Gulf-Red Sea maritime system is straining, and naval and nuclear capabilities are being fielded simultaneously from the Atlantic to the Western Pacific.

- **The Middle East front is widening.** A [joint US–Saudi attack on Iraq](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiaEFVX3lxTFB4SUlTWVVFRE1nWE0yMGhFajNpRnpKZWR2c3U2eWpUT2ZZcjVuQ091YnJfMVNQVFlXSkV3V3ExRDdjanlRaG1FanB6N21pYTU1NmctV2NUYU5hZTZvV3QwbTN6TnMxTnlK) is reported, while [oil prices tumbled after Trump cancelled an attack on Iran](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipwFBVV95cUxQYzJpcHpBNzFaOVcwdHg4SVJ4QkpmdXQtQTA2WDJrWWRHTXh5UVQ0OGNlYThoWm5tbUlkWnVacGlWY2ZtdWhucTNfLXo3TGk5WHltRktNcFNNWjNlSjRHbHVzNnVJaWhWWF9MQ3pLdUlBYy1ZU3ZlN19OV291ZnlsSnpicDFpS0FPZ0VVcGY4REJzQjdJQmtBa3VueEJsWVZ0NXVkS1gtaw), exposing both escalation and whiplash. A senior US general reportedly [cannot be certain of forces to defend Israel](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMirAFBVV95cUxNSU1KMWtvZXFmY3Z6dmw0bk9FLXVzRXZNXzZpeEU3ZGZzdmc2ZzQybWJ2eHFvbHJ0YTZrcDN6YzhaQW1XUkVOV2hHWGlZYS13SDZpNllYbTR1TnlRVDJSczVlWTE2ZFJYZlhNVkZyUTB1cVRIMVlkMTd5QlFIWXMxRzhpN2VzbHdnQU9qMzhabTh1eWNCVXY3dFg2T3lfOVpVQ0oyZUl4RnAxMVFv), and Washington's advice to Americans to leave one Gulf ally raises doubts about [extended deterrence credibility](https://news.google.), and after telling Americans to leave one Gulf ally, can the mighty US military still shield it?
- **Maritime chokepoints are tightening.** [Hormuz transits fell another 52.4% week-on-week](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/31/hormuz-traffic-levels-continue-decreasing-houthis-in-yemen-threaten-saudi-tankers), and the [Red Sea task force is seeing a major jump in escort requests](https://www.twz.com/news-features/red-sea-maritime-security-task-force-commander-talks-major-jump-in-escort-requests) after Houthi threats to Saudi tankers. The [fertilizer supply chain is exposed from Hormuz to Nord Stream](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqgFBVV95cUxPVGg5a08yZXV2R2dJc1I1bGVXcnprSmlOSTRqeDdzZTQxOGtDdHB6VHNYNFQ1T2M0c2gxNkgxeFZ4UEtfTWxOMWdDMHR5b0E4Um9RZjB1bk1oNjIxdEVmZ3Z3TTE2LWx4dE15amVZUmxtYjh5cHJObEIyNTNCa2Jpc2pIVjc4Z2N5eEFNdnFGQ1JsQ1lpM2NYWXJ4SVdmcDJzbG1WdlYwSUs0QQ).
- **Russia-Ukraine is still an industrial air war.** [Russia hit Kyiv with ballistic missiles while Ukrainian drones struck refineries, warehouses, airfields and ships](https://news.google.). Kyiv's air force claims [445,000 Russian aerial targets destroyed](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiS0FVX3lxTE8tN3dGMEU3VmhUaDcyMEFJUEx6cC1nYzVodFVFejZjRU5qeTBGckVlRl9pQTBQcFZuV2hNOG1pRWdYdkJfNUZFbUNSTQ) since 2022, including 91 Kinzhals and 65,000 Shaheds.
- **Naval programs are accelerating.** [Russia floated out the Yasen-M submarine Ulyanovsk](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/08/russia-floats-out-yasen-m-nuclear-submarine-ulyanovsk/), [Rheinmetall unveiled a 6,000-tonne AEGIS frigate](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/08/rheinmetall-unveils-gmf140-frigate/) for North America, and the [PLA Navy launched a YJ-20 hypersonic anti-ship missile from a Type 052D destroyer](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/31/chinese-navy-showcases-hypersonic-anti-ship-capability-aboard-destroyers). [Japan's first Tomahawk firing](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMif0FVX3lxTE5jS3RsZEtOUjZ6aWZWdXJwLTRIeE1OVy1hUFJvNU4wdjFLYmV1Y19Hekt3cVQ2OUxKSHJ6RWVPM1lJa2luZkYycjF5a0Q2TnliUVNTMUl4NzlWTmozRjQxX0xsT0JhZmdGZG9sSlBUcGswcElwajg2OENVeGl5LTg) adds another layer to Indo-Pacific strike capabilities.
- **US force posture is showing strain.** The [F-35B crash at Miramar](https://www.twz.com/air/f-35b-crashes-and-burns-at-marine-corps-air-station-miramar) came as the Navy is asking for a [submarine-launched anti-air missile](https://www.twz.com/sea/u-s-navy-is-seeking-a-submarine-launched-anti-air-missile), a sign of distributed-lethality thinking and platform risk.
- **China is running a signaling campaign in the South China Sea.** Beijing has issued [navigation warnings for military training](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMifEFVX3lxTE5ka0ZZSkNHTTNZTGQzTk1hblVoVklrSUhZRDZWcEtGQl8xMjY2R3Y5em4zaVV6X010aHdyVzBHOElRR2VoZFRzcF9aeUIxellTVFQ0OFR1b1A5YllfeTlGaE9aWjJQVUhsc3oyUF9NQ0FZZV9seVY4SnRnc0s), promoted the [Huangyan Island exercise](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMickFVX3lxTFAtdmpqMHNqd1JWTGJ1Nko2RUsyU25qZkVRUG9ZN2MycExwZWNiV1NEeUMxa29fRzNhSEYxZ21nTGt5S0YyaDB6Y3hfd3dFRTZZaWJwUDJxb0dLajljNXpvS0JfaWNLMlpoUXlsaGwtVm12dw), and responded after Washington added firms to the [Chinese military companies list](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiSEFVX3lxTFBNNkFhZGRLZGRRLTdZQXJmUnkwSnFLNlRPWmhDMXd3WFN1R2tXa0dqTXhhcUJBdTExSEppOUpNZkg5a1AzS20xag).
- **Allied defense-industrial lines are shifting.** [Australian steel is now bound for Virginia-class submarines](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/08/australian-steel-to-support-virginia-class-submarine-construction/), [France is preparing a base for nuclear-capable Rafales](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMigwFBVV95cUxOaGJGTE54OTU1TXhwejZMaEhZVkFHTVdRc2s2VUpRbjE5QmJrbjV1UGc0WGNRdkRuM0t2bEZUaEdhWmlVUGpnTHJiMW5GYnpYSjNGMFl5SkJMV3ZBMjVoa1pQcTZZQkdVVkpwTmx2b3dnUnRWRnRVSW1Eck1WNFdSZmhRRQ), and [Poland has stood up a Space Command](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiwwFBVV95cUxPc0ZWWHJKVFhSNWF5VDZTMkYtTGYwbTVNb2Y2OW5Gbk5sZ3ppUWdlYl85al80cFUtbmxGMVY1bENfdGN5bExSU2M4RXkyWVBVeVZNWk8xalBJbFFFMjlvRjlPdk94Y0kxc3otRlQ1N044ZmpJNDZZU3JGU3ptWXpVbDhHcUpxbEswNUx1OXFZMGNiLVBpUTFjWTlSaE1pNmlNdzkxMzBfZ0dtS201cnA4dlBfTWRxQ0l4SW9EVm83YllpWkE).

**Watch next:** whether US/Saudi strikes in Iraq trigger a major Iranian response, whether Houthi tanker attacks force insurance-driven rerouting, and whether China publishes formal live-fire danger zones in the South China Sea.

tech.zh:
科技板块今日最突出的信号是'分化'：AI行业在IPO与模型竞赛中加速狂奔，而领军者却公开呼吁减速；欧美监管和民意开始踩刹车。硬件端，全球元器件短缺与涨价让消费电子承受压力，折叠屏等品类则进入创新平台期。汽车板块看似平淡，但自动驾驶路线分歧正在水面下扩大。

- [Anthropic提交IPO次日即向150家公司开放Claude Mythos](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMie0FVX3lxTE9EV2ZMWFVyNXhUUnNuUHIweGhRa2NWbWo3WFlmV3d5cUpsX2dIdzZvTmpyT3ZjcWRzNG1LV1VoaDZzYjc3cFNrcFVTS1FfZk5yVzhnS2hWMzZvUGEyQ0lBRmtJalFZRm00a1ZPcWd4VnFXOEF3M3F0U1RNbw)，显示其急于用企业订单支撑估值。

- [阿里巴巴发布Qwen3.8-Max](https://news.google.)，以'最大开源模型'迎战，中国AI军团从'追随'转向'对标'。

- [Sam Altman在播客中呼吁为AI开发'减速'](https://techcrunch.com/2026/08/02/sam-altman-and-ais-decel-debate/)，与上述扩张形成强烈反差。行业内部关于安全优先还是速度优先的争论已经公开化。

- [Reddit CEO质疑Google AI Overviews价值](https://arstechnica.com/ai/2026/08/reddit-ceo-on-ai-overviews-were-still-looking-for-that-win-win/)，称仍在寻找'双赢'。一旦Reddit终止许可，搜索巨头的AI摘要将失去重要内容源。

- [欧盟AI新规](https://www.wired.com/story/europeans-are-about-to-find-out-how-entrenched-ai-is-in-their-daily-lives/)要求明确告知AI交互与AI生成内容，[Gallup调查显示39%美国人对AI持怀疑态度](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMidEFVX3lxTE9OYlhvSkYxeXlDMklvbHNVS2J3UWp4T1BLQ2w1eWFGMlhiMmwycnU3eF82dzh0MlkzRkZkT3dKN1ZQcnJ2T2hzektucU5KUTYwVGpReDJwd2ZQVU9yeEdndWRwWXdjbjduY0V3MThsRGlaMlpX)，监管与民意正在为AI扩张设置新的边界。

- 硬件侧，[MacBook Air遭遇全球内存短缺](https://techcrunch.com/2026/08/02/the-global-memory-shortage-hits-the-macbook-air/)，[Xbox欧洲/英国最高涨价€200/£170](https://www.theverge.com/games/974253/xbox-prices-increasing-200-euros)，[折叠屏手机不再令人兴奋](https://www.theverge.com/column/972937/foldable-phones-boring-apple)，消费电子正同时面对供应链成本和创新疲态。

后续观察：汽车板块本周只有[电动自行车购买指南](https://electrek.co/2026/08/02/here-are-the-best-electric-bikes-you-can-buy-at-every-price-level/)一条直接消息，但[TechCrunch Mobility](https://techcrunch.com/2026/08/02/techcrunch-mobility-two-roads-diverged-for-robotaxis/)指出自动驾驶正走向'两条路'——谨慎商业化与激进扩张。智能眼镜的隐私争议也可能成为下一个全球性话题。
tech.en:
Tech's center of gravity shifted again in the last 24 hours: AI competition broadened from model benchmarks to business models and public trust, while hardware pricing began to crack under memory and console cost pressures. Anthropic moved quickly to commercialize Claude after its IPO filing, Alibaba pushed out its largest model yet, and Reddit's CEO openly questioned whether Google's AI Overviews are worth it. At the same time, European consumers are about to discover how much of their digital life is AI-driven, and US skepticism toward AI rose to 39%.

- [Anthropic opened Claude Mythos to 150 companies](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMie0FVX3lxTE9EV2ZMWFVyNXhUUnNuUHIweGhRa2NWbWo3WFlmV3d5cUpsX2dIdzZvTmpyT3ZjcWRzNG1LV1VoaDZzYjc3cFNrcFVTS1FfZk5yVzhnS2hWMzZvUGEyQ0lBRmtJalFZRm00a1ZPcWd4VnFXOEF3M3F0U1RNbw) just a day after its IPO filing, a sign that Anthropic is converting public-market momentum into enterprise deal flow.
- [Alibaba unveiled Qwen3.8-Max](https://news.google.), its largest AI model yet, intensifying competition with DeepSeek and other Chinese labs.
- [Reddit's CEO questioned the value of Google's AI Overviews](https://arstechnica.com/ai/2026/08/reddit-ceo-on-ai-overviews-were-still-looking-for-that-win-win/) as the stock fell, leaving the company's Google licensing deal in question — the clearest test yet of whether AI search features create or destroy value for content platforms.
- [New EU rules will require disclosure](https://www.wired.com/story/europeans-are-about-to-find-out-how-entrenched-ai-is-in-their-daily-lives/) whenever people interact with AI or see AI-generated/edited content, raising fears of 'disclosure fatigue' across European digital services.
- [US AI skepticism has risen to 39%](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMidEFVX3lxTE9OYlhvSkYxeXlDMklvbHNVS2J3UWp4T1BLQ2w1eWFGMlhiMmwycnU3eF82dzh0MlkzRkZkT3dKN1ZQcnJ2T2hzektucU5KUTYwVGpReDJwd2ZQVU9yeEdndWRwWXdjbjduY0V3MThsRGlaMlpX) per Gallup, and [Sam Altman is calling for a slower AI pace](https://techcrunch.com/2026/08/02/sam-altman-and-ais-decel-debate/) — a notable intersection of public opinion and industry self-regulation.
- [Amazon posted record Q2 revenue of $200.6 billion](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiREFVX3lxTE9UNEQ1S3prbjdLX2VEcDVXSExVNDN1aTZkUmZidXpLSURaZWRBZlQwN3VXTS1CLWtfaXZaSTU2YUkxZFFG), with AWS growth at an 18-quarter high, reinforcing that enterprise AI demand is still the sector's strongest tailwind.
- Hardware costs are hitting consumers: [the global memory shortage has reached the MacBook Air](https://techcrunch.com/2026/08/02/the-global-memory-shortage-hits-the-macbook-air/), and [Xbox prices are rising by up to €200 or £170](https://www.theverge.com/games/974253/xbox-prices-increasing-200-euros) in the EU and UK.
- On the auto desk, [Electrek's August e-bike guide](https://electrek.co/2026/08/02/here-are-the-best-electric-bikes-you-can-buy-at-every-price-level/) was the biggest story — another sign that micro-mobility is now core to the automotive beat.

**Watch next:** Whether Reddit actually follows through on ending its Google deal, how quickly Qwen3.8-Max pulls enterprise workload share, and whether MacBook Air shortages spread to other Apple products as the memory crunch persists.

sports.zh:
过去24小时，体育新闻的密度集中在场外：国际足联遭遇罕见的欧洲足联法律威胁，首个会员协会公开撤回对其主席连任的支持；英超夏窗投入突破10亿英镑并继续加仓；CBA外援市场出现标志性流出。特别提醒：本轮篮球与虎扑资讯流中混入大量博彩平台推广链接，本简报已剔除。

- **FIFA遭遇双线夹击。** 欧足联公开威胁，就因凡蒂诺向私人投资者出售FIFA赛事股份的计划采取法律行动；威尔士足总成为首个公开撤回对因凡蒂诺连任支持的会员协会。两条消息在同一天出现，显示FIFA治理危机正从幕后转向公开对抗。见 [BBC欧足联报道](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/cp30vg829nxo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) 与 [BBC威尔士报道](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/ckg9z094v8go?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)。
- **英超转会窗继续燃烧。** 各队总支出已超过10亿英镑；切尔西以七年长约签下斯特拉斯堡中场巴科，继续押注年轻化。见 [BBC转会盘点](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/c87nxvyq4yqo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) 与 [BBC切尔西签约](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/cdrv6e5m87no?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)。
- **利物浦热身赛崩盘。** 在芝加哥2-0领先利兹联后，利物浦下半场连丢四球，最终2-4告负。新赛季防线轮换和比赛管理能力被打上问号。见 [BBC比赛报道](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/cr7k03gy028o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)。
- **篮球转会市场出现CBA流失信号。** 以色列豪门官宣洛夫顿加盟；这位曾在NBA单场42分14板的外援选择告别CBA。同一天，辽宁球员丛明晨在辽宁省城市篮球联赛与对手发生小冲突，折射休赛期职业球员下沉业余赛事的真实生态。见 [新浪洛夫顿](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiswFBVV95cUxNSXdLNUpCMUE2a25nUTZRdFUyYlF6eFVoYklSeDdEczFwNXU3MUhoTEstR1htVFBHcjVkZlF0bG5ndDh6SVhMM0JOYnY4QmNWRnZRRmg5STYtczdjWV82aFlMMXMxTGd5Yjd5WU84OGsxMnI0T0ZyeFM4ZGRkVjlBMVRFeW9zdEtRS3RkQzBmbGlienRmNlRiUjltR1ZWQmJsTGxOd0llWnI1OVoxWmZMRlF1SQ) 与 [新浪丛明晨](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijwFBVV95cUxQaXBuOEN5MHR0Q24xem1MMVk0N2N0WVRUTXRkQUpDU3g0TVl4QjZlaUxZYXV0ZFNFNU5ROHRfS1dSbm5pdEhqckxCYktIREhiOGVwenp1STNCMi1BSWkxa2d0OE1iU1ZwYkZ4YVFvOGRJVXdLOGZfMWlmYmxMbnJibmk1WEFjTGVPNXVrSjE5MA)。
- **羽毛球新星冒头，但一条传闻需谨慎。** 台北公开赛落幕，日本冲本优大与印度小将夏尔马分别夺冠。中文网络同时流传“奥运冠军张军被查”，截至发稿无官方通报，只宜标注存疑，不建议定性。见 [8world](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMidEFVX3lxTE9pQThqQTM4ZlowRHlMY0R6eDhnSjJkdzJDUE13Q0FpUGJzaHRKNXlqNjZmY0ZDb2loeUlRejhsSjNCOEJrRHVDQXAtM0Y4dC1pc1JjbEdjRDU2TWU1aC04VGtycEZOdjVISndUX3RtRVlrdHFn) 与 [手机新浪网](https://news.google.)。
- **虎扑社区进入榜单季。** “虎扑男神大赛”夺冠话题与姆巴佩法甲制造进球榜（254球第一）并列高热，平台内容从赛事讨论向泛娱乐和数据库迁移。见 [娱乐报道](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiS0FVX3lxTE1HcjltU1VCbVEtUGZKNUZROXRJalREZjZxT251eEVTUlVQa2h4YXdOVTY3cGJVeURvRUkzV3lLMDY2eVVoQ01PTjRNcw) 与 [腾讯新闻](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE0xRG9XNWU2VE9WTUwwb2V3VWk5eG9DeDViZGNhMEJnb1Z4eVIyaEt0bHlBSHpHdTNJZm9vUklyc0s4Vzk4NEt0NFhweDNNR2pGWUl5VENIUGhyYmZ5NTR0V3ZB)。

**后续观察：** 关注FIFA会员协会是否出现“多米诺骨牌”；英超夏窗最后三周是否有亿元级交易；CBA外援引进与流失是否形成连锁反应；张军相关传闻是否获得权威信源证实。
sports.en:
Over the last 24 hours, sports media moved in two directions: powerful institutions clashed at the top of global football, while Chinese fan channels were flooded by gambling-adjacent app promotion. The most consequential news was organizational — UEFA's legal threat to FIFA and Wales' public break with Gianni Infantino — but the loudest noise came from pre-season football, transfer spending, and a thick layer of junk sports content. Below is the section-level view across basketball, football, badminton, and Hupu community signals.

- **FIFA under pressure:** UEFA threatened legal action over Infantino's plan to sell stakes in FIFA competitions; Wales became the first national association to withdraw support for his re-election. The combination signals a coordinated pushback before the FIFA Congress. [BBC UEFA](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/cp30vg829nxo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) / [BBC Wales](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/ckg9z094v8go?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)
- **Premier League cash:** Clubs have spent more than £1bn and are expected to accelerate; Chelsea signed Argentina midfielder Valentin Barco on a seven-year deal. [BBC spend](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/c87nxvyq4yqo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) / [BBC Barco](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/cdrv6e5m87no?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)
- **Manchester United women:** Marc Skinner left after five years, opening a major coaching vacancy just before the new season. [Sky](https://www.skysports.com/football/news/12040/13569329/marc-skinner-manchester-united-womens-head-coach-leaves-club-after-five-years-in-charge)
- **Pre-season signals:** Liverpool lost 4-2 to Leeds after leading 2-0; new Man City boss Enzo Maresca is winning early praise from Antoine Semenyo; Everton's European hopes and Moyes' return are under scrutiny. [BBC Liverpool](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/cr7k03gy028o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) / [BBC Semenyo](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/cglj1zz5g92o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) / [BBC Everton](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/cy5dw9xeekvo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)
- **China basketball reality check:** Cong Mingchen's on-court dust-up in the Liaoning city league and Kenneth Lofton Jr.'s move from CBA to an Israeli club were the only substantive basketball items; most "basketball news" in the feed was commercial spam. [Sina Cong](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijwFBVV95cUxQaXBuOEN5MHR0Q24xem1MMVk0N2N0WVRUTXRkQUpDU3g0TVl4QjZlaUxZYXV0ZFNFNU5ROHRfS1dSbm5pdEhqckxCYktIREhiOGVwenp1STNCMi1BSWkxa2d0OE1iU1ZwYkZ4YVFvOGRJVXdLOGZfMWlmYmxMbnJibmk1WEFjTGVPNXVrSjE5MA) / [Sina Lofton](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiswFBVV95cUxNSXdLNUpCMUE2a25nUTZRdFUyYlF6eFVoYklSeDdEczFwNXU3MUhoTEstR1htVFBHcjVkZlF0bG5ndDh6SVhMM0JOYnY4QmNWRnZRRmg5STYtczdjWV82aFlMMXMxTGd5Yjd5WU84OGsxMnI0T0ZyeFM4ZGRkVjlBMVRFeW9zdEtRS3RkQzBmbGlienRmNlRiUjltR1ZWQmJsTGxOd0llWnI1OVoxWmZMRlF1SQ)
- **Badminton:** Taipei Open produced Japanese and Indian winners; a viral report claims Olympics champion Zhang Jun is under investigation, but no official confirmation. [Taipei Open](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMidEFVX3lxTE9pQThqQTM4ZlowRHlMY0R6eDhnSjJkdzJDUE13Q0FpUGJzaHRKNXlqNjZmY0ZDb2loeUlRejhsSjNCOEJrRHVDQXAtM0Y4dC1pc1JjbEdjRDU2TWU1aC04VGtycEZOdjVISndUX3RtRVlrdHFn) / [Zhang Jun report](https://news.google.)
- **Hupu community:** Fan-driven content ranged from Mbappe's Ligue 1 record (254 goal involvements) to Khedira's Real Madrid reunion and Wang Chuqin's table tennis season wrap. [Ligue 1 list](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE0xRG9XNWU2VE9WTUwwb2V3VWk5eG9DeDViZGNhMEJnb1Z4eVIyaEt0bHlBSHpHdTNJZm9vUklyc0s4Vzk4NEt0NFhweDNNR2pGWUl5VENIUGhyYmZ5NTR0V3ZB) / [Khedira](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiVkFVX3lxTE9kbE1FRlRCTEFBR3N1dXlIaTdPQlhKU2lGREo1Q1hac2Njd2pmMTVWdjB1QS1lWElfUVp1S1M5LVh4cnlTdVdVVTBzOW1RcGl5VF80QWRB) / [Wang](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTFBVcXNzeTdrZWZaaFpDT0prZnlpT0xzOGpQbkZTekQ2WWs2MHJZSHN0UnF2ZGx2dnpIVVhnUTluVFpxVFVTbzRBUHlueTRjaGctOWU1am5ZZTZLTjR1dHJYeVFR)
- **Information quality warning:** A TGBUS cluster pushed "KUYOU", "Mamba Sports", "c7", "Yaxin", "Yafu", poker and mahjong apps into basketball and Hupu desks; these are commercial placements, not sports journalism. [Mamba sample](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiWEFVX3lxTFBkbkt5NWx1ZlpkeE5IcG80YURLZmFfNV9FREJOU3c0NWJHcGpxOFhnT290TEZTWFk5SGloSDN0LU81c1lLYVdpX0E4b0dBZWhWWEF6UTE0Mng) / [Mahjong sample](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiW0FVX3lxTE5vRERTdHFxaFl0dVZxUnNQdUs5QUxDcE1uQkdiR3pFZncxOTR1eE85N1JlLWVYNm5Nd3Fsem1qaVR5cUZoTDAyN1ZIMHpMTTM1NXR1bzFGWUhXekU)

**Watch next:** The FIFA/UEFA legal standoff and Wales' defection could escalate ahead of the next FIFA Congress; Premier League clubs are expected to keep spending into deadline week; and Chinese sports desks should watch whether the gambling-promo flood spreads beyond TGBUS outlets into mainstream feeds.

entertainment.zh:
**娱乐板块综述**
过去24小时，娱乐新闻的三大主线是：好莱坞大片在亚洲市场创造票房奇观、艺人政治表达在东南亚遭遇执法反弹、韩剧与K-pop进入8月上新密集期。同时，中国微博热搜与监管动态共同塑造着本土娱乐生态。

- [韩国票房](https://variety.com/2026/film/box-office/korea-box-office-spider-man-brand-new-day-81-percent-market-share-1236826175/)：Spider-Man: Brand New Day在韩国拿下81%市场份额，三天报收1690万美元、225万观影人次；[中国票房](https://variety.com/2026/film/box-office/china-box-office-spider-man-brand-new-day-121-million-1236826171/)则显示该片在中国大陆五天进账1.213亿美元，两大亚洲市场同步验证超级英雄IP的统治力。
- Massive Attack因演唱会展示巴勒斯坦国旗，演出后遭新加坡警方拘留、单独盘问及护照没收。乐队发声明称“未料到展示一个获157国承认的主权国家国旗会违法”，[Rolling Stone](https://www.rollingstone.com/music/music-news/massive-attack-singapore-palestinian-flag-response-1235602364/)与[Variety](https://variety.com/2026/music/news/massive-attack-duo-banned-singapore-palestinian-flag-1236825534/)的报道可互相印证，事件已从演艺新闻发酵为国际言论自由议题。
- 韩剧暑期档下半场开启：tvN漫改爱情剧《My Bias, My Boss》今晚首播，金慧埈、姜勋、车佑旻主演；同档期还有李敏贞离婚题材新剧《OK, Let's Get Divorced》和宋康等主演的音乐青春剧《Four Hands, Two Sonatas》释出物料，[Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1859610wpp/kim-hye-juns-long-awaited-chance-to-meet-her-bias-cha-woo-min-slips-away-in-my-bias-my-boss)称追星设定下老板与粉丝的浪漫冲突。
- 欧美剧集方面，《龙之家族》第三季第7集出现Aemond与Alys、Alicent的争议性亲密场景，主演Gayle Rankin接受[Variety](https://variety.com/2026/tv/news/house-of-the-dragon-aemond-alys-rivers-alicent-sex-eggs-1236824981/)采访称该戏份“F—ed Up”，剧集口碑与观众接受度的拉扯仍在继续。
- 中国微博热搜上，易烊千玺“纪念照打码事件”与张凌赫父母旧照被扒并列出现，[新浪](https://news.google.)称粉丝追问原图；蔡徐坤澳门演唱会大屏错位则被粉丝“玩梗”化解，展示了饭圈应对危机的新方式。
- 中国网络娱乐监管加码：中央网信办从严处置一批违规网络娱乐团播账号，[中新网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiaEFVX3lxTFA3LUp1TGNSNWtMTVEtaEI2Sk5RWEliRDBUUl8xOS1GZC04Q1dqYXYtNEdMM3NkSjBkUVhtMTRQdm9BWVIycHZaM2d6Nllnb1ZrYWJRejdRdXJNMlJQYVB5U3pDNl9PVXdO)指治理对象为“团播”中的违规内容，直播打赏与诱导消费或成重点。
- K-pop在中国舆论场保持存在感：KiiiKiii新曲《Pop Off Pop Off》今日TikTok先公开，BOYNEXTDOOR官宣8月日本数码单曲+9月正规一辑改版，[中国娱乐网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiW0FVX3lxTE5HZ1R5M1lkWE1kYU9UX2ZOdHM3dEYxeTJxYzhLMEdtN3g1MzEtSVRSd0lPUUM2Y1BEWjNpZE1yYUtFQTR1QXRIcjcteENsTVBuSWFpYVE4RDdtRjQ)与[相关报道](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiW0FVX3lxTFBFQ0dZYkE5YTZpdzB5aXRuQV9hTllqajQ4NEcyVHB6Z3A0T1lQcHQ0VkNFU1BEcUxLWDBObjYxOWVlVjVMUF9zaUVpM1RSSm9TXzItYzQyUS1EQ2M)显示跨国回归节奏加速。

**后续观察**：需追踪《蜘蛛侠》次周票房跌幅及亚洲总盘能否创系列新高；Massive Attack事件是否影响后续西方艺人在东南亚巡演的审批；《My Bias, My Boss》首播口碑将决定tvN近期剧集热度；中国团播治理是否会向秀场直播与打赏体系延伸。
entertainment.en:
The last 24 hours in entertainment are defined by a single commercial signal — the global box-office muscle of 'Spider-Man: Brand New Day' — and by cultural flashpoints over artist expression, livestream regulation, and fandom privacy. From Seoul to Singapore to Beijing, the stories below show where audiences are spending, where artists are pushing limits, and where regulators are starting to draw lines.

- 'Spider-Man: Brand New Day' delivered a colossal debut on two fronts: South Korea gave it $16.9m from 2,252,930 admissions and an 81% market share over Jul. 31-Aug. 2 ([Variety](https://variety.com/2026/film/box-office/korea-box-office-spider-man-brand-new-day-81-percent-market-share-1236826175/)), while mainland China generated RMB463.5m ($68.1m) in its three-day frame and $121.3m in five days ([Variety](https://variety.com/2026/film/box-office/china-box-office-spider-man-brand-new-day-121-million-1236826171/)). The takeaway is not just Hollywood's resilience in Asia, but the increasingly synchronized global launch calendar for tentpoles.

- Massive Attack escalated its public confrontation with Singapore authorities: the band says members were detained, isolated, and separately questioned after the show, with hotel searches and temporary passport confiscation ([Variety](https://variety.com/2026/music/news/massive-attack-duo-banned-singapore-palestinian-flag-1236825534/); [Rolling Stone](https://www.rollingstone.com/music/music-news/massive-attack-singapore-palestinian-flag-response-1235602364/)). For touring artists, this is a new benchmark for political-expression risk in restrictive jurisdictions.

- Locarno Pro is making AI, algorithms, and consolidation the center of its industry agenda, with Uruguay as spotlight country ([The Hollywood Reporter](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/movies/movie-news/locarno-pro-2026-preview-ai-algorithm-mergers-creative-film-1236649968/)). For independent producers, the conversation moves from abstract fear to concrete deal terms.

- K-drama supply is entering a crowded August: tvN premieres the webtoon-based romance 'My Bias, My Boss' tonight ([Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1859610wpp/kim-hye-juns-long-awaited-chance-to-meet-her-bias-cha-woo-min-slips-away-in-my-bias-my-boss)), and a roundup counts at least eight new shows for the month ([Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1857957wpp/8-new-k-dramas-to-watch-in-august-2026)). Rom-com/webtoon IP remains the safest bet in the Korean market.

- China's internet regulator signaled a new round of enforcement against illegal 'entertainment group' livestream accounts ([chinanews](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiaEFVX3lxTFA3LUp1TGNSNWtMTVEtaEI2Sk5RWEliRDBUUl8xOS1GZC04Q1dqYXYtNEdMM3NkSjBkUVhtMTRQdm9BWVIycHZaM2d6Nllnb1ZrYWJRejdRdXJNMlJQYVB5U3pDNl9PVXdO)). This will hit multi-host livestream operations and the agencies that rely on them, and it accelerates the compliance burden for platforms.

- Weibo's entertainment timeline is caught between fan play and privacy pain: Zhang Linghe's parents' old photos were dug up and trended under a 'privacy pain' headline ([Sina](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipgFBVV95cUxOYV9fM2hPYjJwNTZiVDVCOTFkbzBhU1VaWmRweFVXZXFFWTFzNjc5STZQcjZJbnlFZ2ZaMWFXb0p5TUh6TmdMRUhNWXhYQmVEbjFKeDliMFI4bGtTVUUycnc1VUIwaUJVQnAzamVwSjZ1UEhfbHBNaDJ1Q2RqcGpfWUhhdzl4WXBRMnlUZnBCTDdPblRzMkFXLXJqMHY3MlozU3ItSVpn)), while Jackson Yee's blurred commemorative photo still has fans asking for the unblurred original ([Sina](https://news.google.)). Agencies need to treat archival photos as a PR risk, not just content.

- The late-night/politics crossover remains a major U.S. entertainment beat: John Oliver attacked the Trump administration and RFK Jr. over FDA/CDC cuts during a parasite crisis, using Taco Bell as an unlikely moral benchmark ([The Hollywood Reporter](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/tv/tv-news/john-oliver-parasite-outbreak-trump-kennedy-1236662384/)). For audiences, it shows how entertainment talk shows are filling the accountability gap.

Watch next: Track 'Spider-Man: Brand New Day' holdover rates in China and Korea, the premiere-week performance of 'My Bias, My Boss' and 'Love in Disguise,' and whether Weibo's privacy backlash pushes agencies to change how they distribute archival material.

美股.zh:
概览：美股在风险偏好回升中等待新数据。地缘缓和压制油价，美日干预汇率成为焦点，医疗并购消息提振板块叙事。

- 特朗普称伊朗谈判周一恢复，原油单日重挫逾5%，能源股承压，但航空、消费等成本压力暂缓。[油价](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/08/03/oil-prices-today-wti-brent-hormuz-trump-iran.html)
- 美日确认周五联合买入日元，为近年罕见协调行动，美元走弱，跨国企业盈利与套息交易或受扰动。[干预](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/08/03/yen-intervention-us-japan-trump-bessent-katayama.html)
- 阿斯利康与BMS洽谈4000亿美元合并，若成功将改变全球制药竞争格局，生物科技板块可能迎来重估。[并购](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/08/02/astrazeneca-and-bristol-myers-squibb-mull-400-billion-deal-report-.html)
- 美联储就银行内部人贷款和互助银行规则征求意见，显示加强金融监管的新动向。[美联储](https://www.federalreserve.gov/newsevents/pressreleases/bcreg20260731b.htm)

收束：短期美股或维持“地缘缓和+并购预期”支撑，但需警惕AI板块波动与美联储政策不确定性。
美股.en:
US equity news was dominated by de-escalation in the Middle East, a historic U.S.-Japan FX operation and a reported $400 billion pharma combination. Energy names are likely to lead the S&P 500 lower as oil prices repriced, while pharma M&A speculation could support healthcare.

- **Oil sells off**: WTI and Brent fell more than 5% after Trump called off strikes on Iran and confirmed talks will resume Monday. Investors cut geopolitical risk premiums sharply. [Oil drops over 5%](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/08/03/oil-prices-today-wti-brent-hormuz-trump-iran.html) | [Trump says Iran talks to resume](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/08/03/trump-iran-us-negotiations-peace-proposals-.html)
- **Yen intervention spillover**: Japan and the U.S. confirmed coordinated yen-buying on Friday and signaled more to come. This could affect U.S. Treasury yields and multinational earnings through currency moves. [U.S., Japan confirm](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/08/03/yen-intervention-us-japan-trump-bessent-katayama.html) | [BBC: rare joint move](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cglj1pr0wjwo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)
- **Mega pharma deal**: AstraZeneca and Bristol Myers Squibb are reportedly in talks on a $400 billion merger. Any deal would face deep antitrust scrutiny and reshape oncology/immunology pipelines. [AstraZeneca in talks with BMS](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/08/02/astrazeneca-and-bristol-myers-squibb-mull-400-billion-deal-report-.html)
- **Federal Reserve proposals**: The Fed asked for comment on modernizing rules for bank insider lending and mutual banking organizations, and issued enforcement actions against banks and former employees. [Fed insider lending proposal](https://www.federalreserve.gov/newsevents/pressreleases/bcreg20260731b.htm) | [Fed mutual banking proposal](https://www.federalreserve.gov/newsevents/pressreleases/bcreg20260731a.htm)
- **Consumer strength**: “Spider-Man: Brand New Day” posted a $355 million domestic opening, the second-highest in history, a positive signal for entertainment spending. [Spider-Man box office](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/08/02/spider-man-brand-new-day-box-office-355-million-domestic-opening.html)

**Next signal**: Watch whether oil prices hold their post-de-escalation lows and whether AstraZeneca/BMS issue statements; both will set the tone for Tuesday’s U.S. session.

中国经济.zh:
概览：A股在AI抛售中剧烈分化，政策端则持续加码。社保基金增持、核电核准、国债期货落地，显示“国家队”与改革工具共同托底。

- 全国社保基金前7个月显著增持A股，给市场注入信心，但上半年沪深300仍跌2.16%，稳市仍需更多增量资金。[社保](https://www.scmp.com/business/banking-finance/article/3362766/chinas-social-security-fund-boosts-stakes-share-firms-first-7-months-data-shows)
- 港交所推出5年期中国国债期货，国际机构参与热情高，助推人民币资产国际化。[国债](https://www.scmp.com/business/markets/article/3362586/global-institutional-investors-eager-trade-chinese-bond-futures-hong-kong-hkex-says)
- 国务院核准8个核电机组，核电板块集体大涨；同时AI应用概念爆发，但算力硬件股重挫，科创50收跌5.08%，市场风格快速切换。[核电](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitgFBVV95cUxQQkJmc3FWZFd2dFg3YV9hM0s1NER3eDE0QlJLVEktdXNONFNFZU9vSVEzU05GbzF1VVBuZC1DWDZLSXVMczVfVnJyUS0tWkFwMlBuTFNnS25GdWZfTm41aU5SeDA4eFFZSWtBcGRoeXpHNTRYU0NjcEJTX1ozR1NtWmZaNm03VTNyTEtFTmFnb3N5MnZRQW9ERk1KYW5RNHpzVnFPTWkzY2ppbE1YMHA3aF9ZaU1Wdw) [A股](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE51ZnVfU2RHMTFkb0d6TGRSdUV6SDJlQWNZNmNJTkM3UUc3S3F4Sl84OVU5eWRqRU9feEMzMF9EanRqN2FfbW53eWJZZm53MEdNV083Qm1YYlhXWkNUSmc)
- 造车新势力7月销量集体环比下滑，市场担忧新一轮价格战，EV板块情绪承压。[EV](https://www.scmp.com/business/china-evs/article/3362717/price-war-fears-grip-chinas-ev-market-after-woeful-july-sales-figures)

收束：中国经济呈现政策托底与产业分化并行，AI回调后需观察增量资金与政策催化能否形成合力。
中国经济.en:
China’s market narrative is splitting: AI hardware is being sold down globally, while policy themes like nuclear power, photovoltaics and government bond futures gain traction. The social security fund’s buying adds a state-backed floor signal at a time when the CSI 300 is under pressure.

- **AI-led slump in tech**: The STAR 50 fell 5.08% as computing power and storage-chip names led losses, with GigaDevice down about 8%. Alibaba rallied on a new AI model, showing differentiation within China tech. [Tonghuashun close](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE51ZnVfU2RHMTFkb0d6TGRSdUV6SDJlQWNZNmNJTkM3UUc3S3F4Sl84OVU5eWRqRU9feEMzMF9EanRqN2FfbW53eWJZZm53MEdNV083Qm1YYlhXWkNUSmc) | [Global Market: China stocks slide](https://news.google.)
- **State fund buying**: China’s social security fund increased A-share stakes in the first seven months, a signal of confidence despite the CSI 300 slipping 2.16% in the first half. [SCMP: social security fund](https://www.scmp.com/business/banking-finance/article/3362766/chinas-social-security-fund-boosts-stakes-share-firms-first-7-months-data-shows)
- **Offshore CGB futures debut**: HKEX launched five-year China government bond futures in Hong Kong, and executives say global asset managers, pension funds and insurers are eager to participate. [SCMP: institutional investors eager](https://www.scmp.com/business/markets/article/3362586/global-institutional-investors-eager-trade-chinese-bond-futures-hong-kong-hkex-says) | [HKEX launches CGB futures](https://news.google.)
- **Stock Connect expansion**: China’s CSRC is pushing broader Stock Connect access, and Wu has vowed further expansion of market links with Hong Kong. [China Daily](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMifkFVX3lxTFA1RXlzM2NZamVsbWpRX3VBaVdGSklPTEdsdm5tSHJSR1AtNWc3VDVEODdZQk9kTWR0SEM3QXNzRzN4S3U3Q21TY1NtQ2o2a3RJbEh5RWc1dDlBU2Q4Qy1pZlRsVU95bm1IUHFFQ2FnYmpWTXpNNC1NZldRNlJXdw) | [Bloomberg: Wu vows expansion](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiswFBVV95cUxOQUJ6U1NNdm1HREVwMmMweHk2emZfQ2FSVmxDN2NUQ0NvR3RFMFhGd0NsQXJvZnkzeVMxQjdoVmpjV0VMaXc0S0NoZFFRRXZaZzItNmF2RTVDal9tOE1qQ1BPdVN0SFNjcTY3bWxiSFdXLW56dklFUGg4cjg0QlUyVmJjUTVpOUZqVFRPVk52My1MYVFpOFZaUTJDcjZlYWN3TFpmOEt6c0xpZ1F5aXZFenJPTQ)
- **EV price-war risk**: Xpeng, Nio and Li Auto all posted July month-on-month sales declines, intensifying fears of another brutal price war as demand weakens. [SCMP: price war fears](https://www.scmp.com/business/china-evs/article/3362717/price-war-fears-grip-chinas-ev-market-after-woeful-july-sales-figures)

**Next signal**: Watch whether the AI-hardware selloff broadens into the wider market, and whether new Hong Kong CGB futures attract liquidity in their first days.

欧洲经济.zh:
概览：欧洲宏观数据与风险事件交织。欧央行确认工资压力温和，但野火成本飙升，能源与气候风险扰动经济前景。

- 欧央行工资追踪器显示2027年一季度协商工资增速为2.7%，表明中期通胀压力可控，为降息路径提供依据。[ECB](https://www.ecb.europa.eu//press/pr/date/2026/html/ecb.pr260729~4ad7508d8a.en.html)
- 欧洲年内野火损失已超30亿欧元，气候灾害正演变为财政与保险业的持续性冲击。[野火](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihAFBVV95cUxPRC1WREloXzdfVWprQlJQYzllTkprWTVCZklsVFhYcTl1LVFJaXk5bmFqdHZ3aFFSc0ROSGt3YTg0dE9ILTlwbUVNODR5MzR4aG5qbHB5TDBvUHkxR1lubHZrOXNocFpxUjNRWEdfakIxeVE5MXF2bmgzWlF0bUROZGdBZ1E)
- 预测机构警告，若霍尔木兹海峡持续关闭，英国将陷入衰退，凸显欧洲能源安全对中东通道的依赖。[英国](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMirwFBVV95cUxPZThlOGd0bjBKTVNSUTZpVjRwZG5hWWZ0X1h0dDNBODRaZHktZEY5T1ZXbHZlYVZQcUNveGhGaXBjSEc4aDA5Ny1XUVR4a3JOc0lCbXdtdEZoTXVlQnQ2bjNpWFR6NGdZVDFpQU83X3dvaWNnSGdiYmNlLVJCRmxsRkt2aU9EN1FjczdfZUFTaElnb3MxSS1iYmswVVZqYW0wSGIwUFNINVZrVXUxckg4)
- 欧股盘前走高，市场等待新数据指引；克鲁格曼发文重估经济超级大国排名，地缘经济学讨论升温。[克鲁格曼](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMie0FVX3lxTFBpckZ0cHVRWjhCTmtwZF9CeEVISmRjMkxiRGpnR3R4VklqSXJxU2RHWlFNTGJ0N0k2TXJiemVDNzdoQzZ4SXA2Q192NlVWaFk2ZTI1MFFPVmQ1WmVJd0hkeWkzNERMWTJubDVXMXk1MU5GWERaUDNfUGQwSQ)

收束：欧洲经济处于“通胀回落但风险上升”的微妙窗口，能源与气候变量可能迫使政策面做出更多应对。
欧洲经济.en:
Euro-area markets are starting the week with firm risk appetite and a benign ECB wage signal. The macro backdrop remains clouded by climate costs and energy-route risk, but rate markets appear to be hunting for a new equilibrium.

- **ECB wage tracker at 2.7%**: The ECB’s tracker for Q1 2027 showed stable negotiated wage pressure, supporting the case that inflation pass-through is cooling. [ECB wage tracker](https://www.ecb.europa.eu//press/pr/date/2026/html/ecb.pr260729~4ad7508d8a.en.html)
- **Digital euro accessibility**: The ECB says the digital euro app will incorporate the highest accessibility standards, a sign of progress toward a retail CBDC. [ECB digital euro](https://www.ecb.europa.eu//press/pr/date/2026/html/ecb.pr260730~3b3bfbb565.en.html)
- **Wildfire costs top €3bn**: European wildfire costs have already surpassed €3 billion this year, adding fiscal and insurance burdens to the region’s economies. [FT: wildfire costs](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihAFBVV95cUxPRC1WREloXzdfVWprQlJQYzllTkprWTVCZklsVFhYcTl1LVFJaXk5bmFqdHZ3aFFSc0ROSGt3YTg0dE9ILTlwbUVNODR5MzR4aG5qbHB5TDBvUHkxR1lubHZrOXNocFpxUjNRWEdfakIxeVE5MXF2bmgzWlF0bUROZGdBZ1E)
- **Hormuz risk to UK**: A forecaster warns the UK would fall into recession if the Strait of Hormuz stayed closed, underscoring Europe’s vulnerability to Gulf supply shocks. [Reuters: UK recession risk](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMirwFBVV95cUxPZThlOGd0bjBKTVNSUTZpVjRwZG5hWWZ0X1h0dDNBODRaZHktZEY5T1ZXbHZlYVZQcUNveGhGaXBjSEc4aDA5Ny1XUVR4a3JOc0lCbXdtdEZoTXVlQnQ2bjNpWFR6NGdZVDFpQU83X3dvaWNnSGdiYmNlLVJCRmxsRkt2aU9EN1FjczdfZUFTaElnb3MxSS1iYmswVVZqYW0wSGIwUFNINVZrVXUxckg4)
- **Market tone**: European equities were higher in premarket trade with data releases in focus, while rates strategists say yields are seeking new levels to settle. [Europe up in premarket](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMilAFBVV95cUxPZlhjRmRVVjFXc0I0UmhpeGo5b25xaTdfNDBtY3NuWVJ6M0Q2cGd4eXZEZ1J4V1FRM2gwRXpnM2N5NWdWZE5ZaXNsOVlfbnJQa19GLUNJcWYyT2FNT2wzM2FoMWlUWTltYnV0LV9feEVza2QwdTZ1LXhpeXRvVmpsSFdlTEVGMW00V3M5OVhPMTNjSlhN) | [Rates Spark](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiigFBVV95cUxPRlV5NkVCcURwVEhrQUNKNDZtaExRMXhmbm8yNXoxTkxXMjV6UXdocnUtRW5NQlBJU3JlaThDbjZpc0lXcEVRQ3BBUlM2UUhlSmxYc3hmMUh6TlZIdTZhcnJDR0pFdlU5UDVmbS1UNzNNYm1xTGVZUDEyUTRRTG1ZZ29yUGY3RGZFRWc)

**Next signal**: Watch euro-area data prints and ECB speakers to see whether the 2.7% wage figure keeps September rate-cut expectations intact.

同花顺社区动态.zh:
概览：社区复盘聚焦A股缩量分化，核电与AI应用爆发，算力硬件遭弃，同时期货市场受地缘消息扰动剧烈。

- 大盘缩量回调，超3700只个股上涨，但科创50跌5.08%——权重股与普惠赚钱效应背离，社区情绪谨慎乐观。[收评](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE9oRVNZeVNvRlViX0VzbjRkSXYxa2hMc1JSOE40ZDdYWGxKQXhtYWEtd19iMUQ4TUdXcWNWTWFDa0NDQW5GYU1PTDNWTXd3ZUFiMmlKTkpLY1NZSms0VkdxcER3)
- 核电、光伏逆势爆发，存储芯片重挫，兆易创新跌近8%，半导体设备与AI算力成杀跌重灾区。[个股](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE5CMC05Vmo1QUdMazcyY2dfdDNncjBqRWhxZzZzc1lQX0dYYS0wRjlURmRubDF2LXprVGwyT3c4N3QxZDJpTHh0TXAyYkFXbGdPT1Q1dENnN1J0eGw1Z1VORUpn)
- 期货收评：美伊再传谈判消息，原油系集体重挫；多晶硅却触及9%涨停，资金转向新能源材料。[期货](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE02YTNkdXp6MDM3LUR2VWI2RGYxUUJ0c1BFLWs5R3FtRTZIVXFCUWs0a09PUmxTWTVaMHREN05wQmVoQnhRUm5mSzlqMkE1Rk1FMnpzamxEc09qcVYxRmc)
- 上周ETF资金整体净流入946.78亿元，显示机构资金借道指数产品布局A股。[ETF](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE55NktBRWIzdms4cHB6Vklaemg2VUpDLUZVeUNFeUdKNU9yZWxSVGdXSmhSTDM2NV9PSVdjVUF6c2dLN2cyY09oWXFQV3g4akVZa09WazVnQnhtU1pzVkE)

收束：社区焦点从“指数涨跌”转向“结构博弈”，资金在核电、AI应用与超跌资源品间快速轮动，追高风险值得警惕。
同花顺社区动态.en:
Tonghuashun community data show a clear rotation: retail investors are chasing policy themes such as nuclear, photovoltaics and AI applications, while dumping storage chips and computing hardware. ETF inflows remain a supportive undercurrent.

- **Market close**: A-share turnover shrank, but more than 3,700 stocks rose; nuclear power and photovoltaic names surged, while semiconductor equipment and storage chips fell, with GigaDevice down nearly 8%. [Tonghuashun close](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE9oRVNZeVNvRlViX0VzbjRkSXYxa2hMc1JSOE40ZDdYWGxKQXhtYWEtd19iMUQ4TUdXcWNWTWFDa0NDQW5GYU1PTDNWTXd3ZUFiMmlKTkpLY1NZSms0VkdxcER3) | [Detail: >3,700 stocks rise](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE5CMC05Vmo1QUdMazcyY2dfdDNncjBqRWhxZzZzc1lQX0dYYS0wRjlURmRubDF2LXprVGwyT3c4N3QxZDJpTHh0TXAyYkFXbGdPT1Q1dENnN1J0eGw1Z1VORUpn)
- **Commodity futures**: Oil-linked contracts slumped after fresh US-Iran negotiation headlines, while polysilicon touched a 9% limit-up, reflecting diverging thematic bets. [Tonghuashun futures recap](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE02YTNkdXp6MDM3LUR2VWI2RGYxUUJ0c1BFLWs5R3FtRTZIVXFCUWs0a09PUmxTWTVaMHREN05wQmVoQnhRUm5mSzlqMkE1Rk1FMnpzamxEc09qcVYxRmc)
- **ETF flows**: Last week saw net inflows of 94.68 billion yuan into ETFs, showing resilient demand for index-based exposure even amid tech volatility. [Tonghuashun ETF flows](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE55NktBRWIzdms4cHB6Vklaemg2VUpDLUZVeUNFeUdKNU9yZWxSVGdXSmhSTDM2NV9PSVdjVUF6c2dLN2cyY09oWXFQV3g4akVZa09WazVnQnhtU1pzVkE)
- **Pipeline and bond deals**: Shenzhen Gas and Dongguan state capital set up a natural gas pipeline network company, while Sanmenxia High-Tech Industrial Investment proposed a 500 million yuan corporate bond accepted by the Shanghai Stock Exchange. [Shenzhen Gas JV](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTFBMdUVlMlpfelBZTk0xVGt3YUlvZzlRWDd4ZjJaUm84MndfUUJrd3dxeUdackFpWkd4NU91Zlo1MnJZcFY2M05USHU1Q0MwRWVGV1pJVDY2cXVqWkNxNFlQX2R3) | [Sanmenxia bond](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE55NldKVEJIdGY4RFBjcWFwd0FlejNpUXZzTFdmOThNTFVNMUc4bk1qVXZ5Z1lxNW5CeHRlVW9LdTNIdU0wZGF5bERKenBDcW1sbGphcVhVU1dHckpyb0x6RGF3)

**Next signal**: Watch whether retail flow rotation out of AI hardware into applications/policy themes continues, and whether ETF inflows offset further tech downside.

欧美.zh:
欧美媒体的社会版仍由冲突与人道议题主导：哈马斯解除武装协议没有换来停火，以色列空袭持续；特朗普宣布的美伊谈判与德黑兰的否认形成张力。文娱与公共安全事故也构成另一条线索。
- 加沙伤亡是最大变量：BBC称空袭致至少13死，NPR报道含儿童至少17死，并引述以方对协议“严重关切”；伤亡数字差异本身说明地面混乱仍在持续。[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/czjlvvkzj20o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) [NPR](https://www.npr.org/2026/08/03/g-s1-136877/israel-serious-concerns-hamas-disarmament-deal-trump)
- 伊朗外交部否认当前谈判，与特朗普“周一开始”说法矛盾；此前停火尝试多次反复，需以行动而非表态判断。[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2026/8/3/iran-war-live-trump-says-talks-set-to-begin-tehran-urges-us-to-honour-mou?traffic_source=rss)
- Ariana Grande宣布退出公众视野，原因直指“无尽检视”，是名人心理健康议题的又一案例。[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c80ngjjvevyo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)
- 希腊两架消防直升机相撞致2名机组死亡，1名英国飞行员幸存；极端天气下的应急作业风险值得关注。[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c1417713ve6o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)
- Massive Attack因演唱会喊“自由巴勒斯坦”被新加坡禁止演出，乐队表示失望，事件放大艺术表达与政治规制的冲突。[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cr59qe86yj4o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)

收束判断：欧美板块应对中东话题保持“低预期、高敏感”：协议文本只是背景，空袭与制裁等行动才会决定社会面的下一步。
欧美.en:
Overview: The Europe-Americas desk is dominated by conflict and its humanitarian consequences, with Gaza, Iran, Ukraine and Kashmir all producing deaths or diplomatic friction. A softer set of stories—Ariana Grande's hiatus and a school murder trial in Malaysia—shows the section's breadth.

- Gaza: At least 13 people were killed in Israeli strikes on Gaza City, Khan Younis and Deir el-Balah after Hamas agreed to a proposed disarmament deal; Israel says it targeted military operatives. NPR adds that at least 17 people including children were killed and that Israel has 'serious concerns' about the deal. The humanitarian and political tracks are moving in opposite directions. ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/czjlvvkzj20o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss), [NPR](https://www.npr.org/2026/08/03/g-s1-136877/israel-serious-concerns-hamas-disarmament-deal-trump))
- Iran: Trump said talks with Iran are set to begin Monday, but Iran's foreign ministry said there are no current talks with the U.S. Al Jazeera's live blog captures Tehran's demand that Washington honor a memorandum of understanding; previous cycles show this kind of optimism can collapse into resumed strikes. ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c23579jzv08o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss), [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2026/8/3/iran-war-live-trump-says-talks-set-to-begin-tehran-urges-us-to-honour-mou?traffic_source=rss))
- Ukraine: Ukraine says it hit a major Russian oil refinery and an airfield; Moscow reported eight deaths and said its military attacked Ukrainian ports and vessels in the Black Sea. This is an escalation focused on energy and export infrastructure, with direct global commodity implications. ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c998gg5pe09o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss))
- Markets: The dollar weakened sharply against the yen after President Trump and Japan's finance minister both confirmed market intervention. The rare joint confirmation surprised markets and may increase pressure on other central banks to respond. ([NPR](https://www.npr.org/2026/08/03/g-s1-136866/us-dollar-japanese-yen-market-interventions))
- Society: In Pakistan-administered Kashmir, a mother tells the BBC that her only son was shot while standing up for justice during deadly protests in Rawalakot. In Greece, two crew members died as firefighting helicopters collided, and Ariana Grande announced a break from public life amid 'endless' scrutiny. These stories underscore the desk's range beyond combat. ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c5yvqk69enko?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss), [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c1417713ve6o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss), [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c80ngjjvevyo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss))

Closing signal: The key signal is that announced deals are not reducing casualties; watch for further Israeli strikes, any official Iranian reaction to Trump's Monday claim, and whether the yen move triggers more explicit currency intervention.

日韩.zh:
日韩板块最突出的变化是“韩国青年赴日求职”被多家外媒同时报道，标志两国劳动市场从竞争转向互补。与此同时，日本社会的老龄化、反核民意和高温风险构成内部张力。
- 韩国青年因国内就业难转向日本IT/AI岗位，路透、朝日新闻、Japan Times均报道；日本企业同时积极招聘韩国人才，背后是AI人才缺口与薪资、职场文化差异。[Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiwAFBVV95cUxQR1JWMkpuQ1gyX1lnRWpVWktLazExOWJ1UVlkUkFqSV9FOGxZNmFtVXA3TFRyVjBCM0tpdlRYbVp0WEl0VDlFMVhwSlVKX3J2S2NHdUlYd01BOE1WS3JaTTUzTHFhd2VZYW5RRzZ6VGVoX1ZHcmpWNjlXMTRoTDA2eVREZlVydlRSb3JPeV9pMGpYRXVuZ2t2Z3RfZlB6UUVFTFUzSjVQUFNoZlJiMVc4ZTI5Vll2WGpRT2hFUld5N3g) [朝日新闻](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE9nTkx2d0NtMUU1d1p3eHR5bVNSS1FNUS02SXlEVHh4cGxsVUVMVEQxQ3hTMDZXQ215d3luQ3M0SFI4UFVBdXFIdFNnaUFRV00xMkxhMzUtZFRNYVJFX1E)
- 日本高龄 homeless 在极端酷暑中的处境被日本时报专题曝光：经济繁荣的另一面是底层老人缺乏避难所。[Japan Times](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimgFBVV95cUxPN1ZtVWsyemZZbWY4MGxHSlFCYUdfb1dZVlNZb1FZWVFGZ1dqREl0VnYxQ2xLejJhOUllQnhHa243YXE3cTBYTERpSjhIS01TSWdPMkFycnFHNmI1WWluQld3anYtQ0xnRk91enNDSlRzaGtDdzNycjlLbUZITGowWTRMdEFjaTRXS3lxX1I4OXBNRHpoVDVrb2xR)
- 民调显示76%日本民众支持“无核三原则”，专家认为官方推动的松动政策未获民意基础。[Global Times](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE5QZnU2VTZvcFRuTG1IVVV0VHBPNk96RWdUdVFZd0xodjAwbFd1Xy1KdVNGYkVmRXVPYThUQjJaUURIb2RBX1oxSjFPRlJwSFZiQW5WMExBUUlnQ091WjdEb1pn)
- 韩国正经历持续高温，台风又带来不确定性，公共服务与弱势群体保护进入临战状态。[Korea Herald](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiV0FVX3lxTE5ZRmZmNUdBd3JySkFhcjctdGc4LUlGM2QxaDlOejZvX251MVNwcDh3cTNEUWR4NVV5UHlrNWtFak1TSkJiQ3JxdEZ1TnZzTjVHUW1hT2tJcw)

收束判断：如果日韩双向人才流动持续，将倒逼两国在签证、养老和IT教育政策上作出调整；这是未来数月亚洲劳动市场的重要变量。
日韩.en:
Overview: The Japan-Korea desk is defined by cross-border labor movement and summer risks. Young South Koreans are struggling to find work at home and increasingly looking to Japan, while Japanese firms are trying to hire South Korean IT/AI talent. Heat and homelessness are putting Japan's safety net under pressure.

- Labor migration: Young South Koreans look for jobs in Japan as they struggle to find work at home—a story repeated by Reuters, Asahi Shimbun, Japan Times and Devdiscourse. The Times of India adds that Japanese companies are increasingly hiring South Korean IT/AI talent, indicating a structural match between Korea's labor surplus and Japan's skills shortage. ([Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiwAFBVV95cUxQR1JWMkpuQ1gyX1lnRWpVWktLazExOWJ1UVlkUkFqSV9FOGxZNmFtVXA3TFRyVjBCM0tpdlRYbVp0WEl0VDlFMVhwSlVKX3J2S2NHdUlYd01BOE1WS3JaTTUzTHFhd2VZYW5RRzZ6VGVoX1ZHcmpWNjlXMTRoTDA2eVREZlVydlRSb3JPeV9pMGpYRXVuZ2t2Z3RfZlB6UUVFTFUzSjVQUFNoZlJiMVc4ZTI5Vll2WGpRT2hFUld5N3g), [Asahi](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE9nTkx2d0NtMUU1d1p3eHR5bVNSS1FNUS02SXlEVHh4cGxsVUVMVEQxQ3hTMDZXQ215d3luQ3M0SFI4UFVBdXFIdFNnaUFRV00xMkxhMzUtZFRNYVJFX1E), [Times of India](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi-))
- Aging homeless: Japan's aging homeless population faces brutal, inescapable summers, reports the Japan Times. Heat is becoming a lethal public-health issue for a group that policy tends to ignore. ([Japan Times](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimgFBVV95cUxPN1ZtVWsyemZZbWY4MGxHSlFCYUdfb1dZVlNZb1FZWVFGZ1dqREl0VnYxQ2xLejJhOUllQnhHa243YXE3cTBYTERpSjhIS01TSWdPMkFycnFHNmI1WWluQld3anYtQ0xnRk91enNDSlRzaGtDdzNycjlLbUZITGowWTRMdEFjaTRXS3lxX1I4OXBNRHpoVDVrb2xR))
- Nuclear sentiment: A poll shows 76% of Japanese support maintaining the Three Non-Nuclear Principles; Global Times frames this as strong anti-nuclear public opinion despite Tokyo's push to loosen policy. The numbers remind us of the political ceiling on Japan's nuclear options. ([Global Times](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE5QZnU2VTZvcFRuTG1IVVV0VHBPNk96RWdUdVFZd0xodjAwbFd1Xy1KdVNGYkVmRXVPYThUQjJaUURIb2RBX1oxSjFPRlJwSFZiQW5WMExBUUlnQ091WjdEb1pn))
- Heat wave: Korea is bracing for a prolonged heat wave as a typhoon adds uncertainty, according to The Korea Herald. That combination can strain energy grids, agriculture and public health just as summer demand peaks. ([Korea Herald](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiV0FVX3lxTE5ZRmZmNUdBd3JySkFhcjctdGc4LUlGM2QxaDlOejZvX251MVNwcDh3cTNEUWR4NVV5UHlrNWtFak1TSkJiQ3JxdEZ1TnZzTjVHUW1hT2tJcw))
- Culture and sports flashpoints: The Korean dessert brand Tokyo Berry is facing backlash over similarities to Japan's Tokyo Banana, while Hachimura's return to Japan's national team is putting South Korean basketball on alert. Separately, 'The Odyssey' opened in Korea alongside scalper activity, another sign of live-event pricing problems. ([CNA](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMioAFBVV95cUxPcWh5RXZQVWtlYjNic0V5cDRZMDRjQWZxNXlGZkVLVnpBdU1taktoNnRCb0JoaS1aTDE4cXAtVmRiblB4NFlpZE5QcnRBWTUxRWtKWWVMXzlwUnRfWE5YOWxKRlFGTXN3c1ZxUExSZjFMVnpfLVRmSlBQQ1h6ZE0tRUY1RHVhblM2Q3U5VkRtbFlNN0FNNGpOVUpueVgyTzJm), [Star News Korea](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiekFVX3lxTE43RUNsNi1vck9vNzNWWDlBR0ZiUDBnd2FjYTU0ZVRJdEdIZ0F6ZWQycnFsNVVTLWlNZ3pFeDRmX0hISHNGcW45QXE0cE44ZE94QWhGUGxLalVRNkEtTVNkVHc1eHYxZDdROEU2TVNyWnBvSzBDVlVVTFV3), [Korea Herald](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiV0FVX3lxTE9kUzl5dXh0WXFSaC1iZzdRZ0M0VmR5LXZUMGpwX2JlOE9WZHE5N0FQMXVNTDFreGFIRWZPVzQ0NVpNVWR0OWZFVzVwd2lLS1VxQ2ktbDNYYw))

Closing signal: Watch whether South Korean migration to Japan becomes a measurable labor-market trend, and whether Korea's heat wave forces emergency measures.

中国.zh:
中国板块过去24小时以官方/半官方发布为主，核心是教育供给、医疗外援与基层合规。突发事件不多，但政策信号密集。
- 教育部宣布教育学、心理学新增8本原创教材，指向学科体系补短板；官方尚未披露书单细节。[搜狐/教育部](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiAFBVV95cUxPVWlDbVlYM3oxMVh2LTJTbU5FV1FwWHJmbVZGMlkyTHFvWkp1dDRwcURCWHA2aGZlUWxmNkQ1NWZMbUtKeEJoQ09peS16blFyZlh1OTg2MHBqTDNJZlFWUFZ3TWZJWFo0VmwtVUljY1JZLTk2aTBuNlc0ZVlOMUVfZjFQdnc0RXNZ)
- 2026年暑期中小学生阅读推荐书单发布，为“双减”后假期生活提供新的公共文化供给。[中安在线](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMia0FVX3lxTE9STU9vbHpGNGphLTJiYnVwdXVmQ2tjUkpvbGR0MnQ2cWp3V1hyZVo5NjRVSGxhR0tRMk1Ndk9HYUJLTm5jWmtJR0k3dHlBZlp0RmJxMHR4QUJLSXVqTlF6dEJUVVNkRDk4TU93)
- 重庆“吹牛逼协会海盐分会”等8个非法组织被取缔，名称虽近乎荒诞，但执法信号清晰：以协会名义活动的乱象将继续被清理。[中国甘肃网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiakFVX3lxTE9nUzdVYkhST0EzRDd0U3pFcldIbEVab3pTWWZZc0c3aWNaV1ZiR0QwUGUyR1VWbk1JbWxUNWQ0Vm5jeEZhSTFEblJlNy02WG9wS1c3cUI2dXkyUG41X3NXNUtwNWZlLXVLN0E)
- 第三批中国埃博拉抗疫医疗专家组抵达刚果（金），此前援佛得角医疗队也举行义诊；公共卫生援助的覆盖面和频次在提高。[中国网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMia0FVX3lxTE5lWkc1dk5ROXplZ0RablJTa1ZKVTZJQWNXXzVSa1hyeXFvNUlEMURPYjBCbWxrOHNEQ1hUNERLYXBXU3BIVWM4M01aZGpHWHFFWUZ3NFlUNVN5Z0JpNURieGM3YllNUTJ5YllF) [援佛得角](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMifEFVX3lxTE81M3VaMDY3dXVXNlVxa2N5bXhoT3c5X1pvN1RNZHpqODhpTG9qbE80UDZhMWhicXlUUzVnZ21aU1Zha2Q4VWxsN0V0WE5nbWxfZDYtT0JGY1Yta3oxR0JaU1czSGMyRzZiTC1tSENKbTVwOGdJLTNUT1JmX0w)

收束判断：中国社会新闻的“硬新闻”不多，但教育、医疗、非法组织三条线都关系到公共信任，值得跟进地方执行层面的落地案例。
中国.en:
Overview: China's desk is largely policy- and institution-driven today: new textbooks, a summer reading list, state-media takes on half-year livelihood data, and two African health-diplomacy items. There is also a quirky enforcement story about banned illegal organizations.

- Education: China's Ministry of Education is adding eight original textbooks in education and psychology, according to Sohu, and an official 2026 summer reading list for primary and secondary students was released via Anhui Online. Both are small but concrete signals of curriculum priorities. ([Sohu](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiAFBVV95cUxPVWlDbVlYM3oxMVh2LTJTbU5FV1FwWHJmbVZGMlkyTHFvWkp1dDRwcURCWHA2aGZlUWxmNkQ1NWZMbUtKeEJoQ09peS16blFyZlh1OTg2MHBqTDNJZlFWUFZ3TWZJWFo0VmwtVUljY1JZLTk2aTBuNlc0ZVlOMUVfZjFQdnc0RXNZ), [Anhui Online](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMia0FVX3lxTE9STU9vbHpGNGphLTJiYnVwdXVmQ2tjUkpvbGR0MnQ2cWp3V1hyZVo5NjRVSGxhR0tRMk1Ndk9HYUJLTm5jWmtJR0k3dHlBZlp0RmJxMHR4QUJLSXVqTlF6dEJUVVNkRDk4TU93))
- Livelihood narrative: State media's half-year economic review, via Sina, describes the first-half livelihood 'answer sheet' as warm. Readers should compare that tone against other data points on employment, exports and property for a fuller picture. ([Sina](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMickFVX3lxTE9xcUpQZVl4bkFwa3ZsQlRzb051SnpjRFNkTmRMSkJrUTRBSnp2MFNYQmlIbzVCR1dVdmNUZkJndVhSTHdXamNnM0Uyb2RKRnV5MGMxd3RJLXdDeFNYdHZ6NUNBb3dvTk1rbEJxOXBDS2gxdw))
- Illegal organizations: A group dubbed the 'Chongqing Bullshit Association Haiyan Branch' was among eight illegal organizations banned, according to China Gansu Net. The case shows local regulators can move quickly against unregistered groups, even those with absurd names. ([Gansu](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiakFVX3lxTE9nUzdVYkhST0EzRDd0U3pFcldIbEVab3pTWWZZc0c3aWNaV1ZiR0QwUGUyR1VWbk1JbWxUNWQ0Vm5jeEZhSTFEblJlNy02WG9wS1c3cUI2dXkyUG41X3NXNUtwNWZlLXVLN0E))
- Health diplomacy: China's third expert team for Ebola assistance arrived in DR Congo, and Chinese medical teams held a free clinic in Cape Verde. These deployments reinforce China's health presence in Africa. ([China.com](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMia0FVX3lxTE5lWkc1dk5ROXplZ0RablJTa1ZKVTZJQWNXXzVSa1hyeXFvNUlEMURPYjBCbWxrOHNEQ1hUNERLYXBXU3BIVWM4M01aZGpHWHFFWUZ3NFlUNVN5Z0JpNURieGM3YllNUTJ5YllF), [CIDCA](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMifEFVX3lxTE81M3VaMDY3dXVXNlVxa2N5bXhoT3c5X1pvN1RNZHpqODhpTG9qbE80UDZhMWhicXlUUzVnZ21aU1Zha2Q4VWxsN0V0WE5nbWxfZDYtT0JGY1Yta3oxR0JaU1czSGMyRzZiTC1tSENKbTVwOGdJLTNUT1JmX0w))
- Intellectual climate: Chinese Social Sciences published a special feature on 'answering the questions of the AI era,' while a separate commentary on Phoenix criticizes Chinese economics for a 'collective unconscious' that has drifted away from the economy and the people. Together they hint at a broader social-science recalibration. ([CASS](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMibEFVX3lxTE4tOHdQVDFGTTc4NV81MjZlYnNhWFVRbkt2NThkQkZubjc4anc1Tk0tZHV5bGFfcU1hMlFRU0tWNW1UTnpGam9lT1lyaktKNzExd3AtN2FoSUZ3Mnpuc09oVU95cTJvT190ajhJag), [ifeng](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiTEFVX3lxTE5PemlCYy1HVlBsSnU2cnpXREwzY1JfT1hfRXRWdllGRnJfVzBVSG50UGlmM25vcUt2QlNzX2NhZmg3d093ck5qNXFZa1c))

Closing signal: Watch for more curriculum changes tied to AI and social-science reform, and whether the warm H1 livelihood narrative holds as external economic headwinds strengthen.

知乎社区动态.zh:
知乎社区动态的feed质量出现严重失真，8条信息中大量是“鸿蒙6福利”、博彩App导流和营销号软文，真正的社区讨论被稀释。
- 一条真实的法律问答值得关注：业主欠缴物业费8年，物业起诉试图追回，新浪“红楼知乎”以案例方式呈现结果。[新浪](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMicEFVX3lxTE1lVGV6MG9SRUlqWWVyM1h1emttc0pvMS1IY0RvNkk1aDBfbHZXTG14Q3l0S0hObWJvRkZJajVGVjZuMHJ5WXJaRmJBcy1oR0UxLVhVdFFHTG9Nem1LenQ1YWx1bTZCMzZLM3BtdjhXblA)
- 《蜘蛛侠》找佛得角门将拍宣传片，4A广告网点评“懂流量”，是近期少见的文化营销案例，但经Google News进知乎分类带有明显跳转噪音。[4A广告网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiX0FVX3lxTFAzdjdsSFBlUlcwNU1zODRZN1MtV2ZjLWV4QjB6eGNXTktPZmZnT3o4VFJYLVlzNFJKd1ZLTkk4My1lY1ZZMlI2Wlh1RWp3M3BCMzRxOGQtZVdHTWk1VEY0)
- 多条标题直接指向“欧亚体育”“开元牌棋”“新葡澳娱乐”等App，借鸿蒙6和知乎严选年卡名义导流，属灰产渗透而非社区内容。[电玩巴士](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXEFVX3lxTE5PcGdJSnBHZnhuei1yNVE0TzYzT2Zudk5RaDJ2RHEyTTZqQkZMVnVFUFFvcVBvMWJPQzFHalBCNnZ1YzMxeXNMcjFiT0FtLTFfQk1Pc1ZWQVJjTVBC)
- 知乎2026年度之问被TGBUS标题党化，“bobty体育入口”等乱码显示聚合源已污染，建议删除该信源。[TGBUS](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXEFVX3lxTE9GZ1VUQU1KNmZpamJQVnJleGxaNDZoSVZKbFhWcGxuSW9PUG9SZHZXc3Y1RXgwSkxGbFFnTXJTRFJaMlhoX0p0VU90ZGxCbG5GRm41LTNISkN1MFlD)

收束判断：当前“知乎社区动态”栏目需要做减法：只保留可溯源的原生问答，剔除所有带下载、福利、娱乐App关键词的条目，否则没有情报价值。
知乎社区动态.en:
Overview: Today's Zhihu community desk is a mix of genuine viral content and aggressive spam. The legitimate highlights are a Spider-Man promotional video with Cape Verde's goalkeeper and a property-management fee lawsuit; the rest of the feed is heavily polluted by gambling-related 'HarmonyOS 6 + Zhihu Select annual card' posts.

- Advertising/meme: An ad-industry item notes that Spider-Man's marketing team recruited Cape Verde's goalkeeper for a promotional video—a savvy tie to a viral sports moment. It is a good example of film promotion borrowing sports-meme logic. ([4A](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiX0FVX3lxTFAzdjdsSFBlUlcwNU1zODRZN1MtV2ZjLWV4QjB6eGNXTktPZmZnT3o4VFJYLVlzNFJKd1ZLTkk4My1lY1ZZMlI2Wlh1RWp3M3BCMzRxOGQtZVdHTWk1VEY0))
- Annual question: Zhihu's 2026 'question of the year' is being seeded through gaming media, with SEO clutter around it; the campaign signals Zhihu wants a communal, year-end public-memory moment. ([TGBUS](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXEFVX3lxTE9GZ1VUQU1KNmZpamJQVnJleGxaNDZoSVZKbFhWcGxuSW9PUG9SZHZXc3Y1RXgwSkxGbFFnTXJTRFJaMlhoX0p0VU90ZGxCbG5GRm41LTNISkN1MFlD))
- Practical law: A Zhihu post asks what happens when a property owner owes eight years of management fees and the property company sues to recover the full amount. The case is useful for anyone dealing with long-running property disputes. ([Sina](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMicEFVX3lxTE1lVGV6MG9SRUlqWWVyM1h1emttc0pvMS1IY0RvNkk1aDBfbHZXTG14Q3l0S0hObWJvRkZJajVGVjZuMHJ5WXJaRmJBcy1oR0UxLVhVdFFHTG9Nem1LenQ1YWx1bTZCMzZLM3BtdjhXblA))
- Spam alert: Multiple posts on TGBUS are promoting 'HarmonyOS 6' benefits and claiming that users of certain gambling apps can get a free Zhihu Select annual card. These are unauthorized promotional stunts—likely designed to route users to betting platforms—not official Zhihu offers. ([TGBUS](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXEFVX3lxTE5PcGdJSnBHZnhuei1yNVE0TzYzT2Zudk5RaDJ2RHEyTTZqQkZMVnVFUFFvcVBvMWJPQzFHalBCNnZ1YzMxeXNMcjFiT0FtLTFfQk1Pc1ZWQVJjTVBC), [TGBUS](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiV0FVX3lxTE1hV3QycHg1ZVRycnBuaU5QZmVfZXpma1JMZWJzeUt0RFJkeWRnaXhnR2Y3NzZWeEFUck9VM0dadUJFeU9jRGZiRWtBRG1WLUlmVzhidDU4Zw))
- Leaked content: A post titled 'Alice Bradshaw Leaked Creator-Made Exclusive Content #842' is also circulating, hosted on a site called The Colleges of Law. It is almost certainly spam or pirated material, and its presence underlines weak moderation in the current feed. ([Colleges of Law](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMickFVX3lxTFBXZVg4UHBMR0pYQnpCZnVhTHlXVFNndXBIbGYyWFlMbFdFN3VPQzV3OHIxMko5VUdkQjJjZFc2eDV2TVpsMUNkSGxOVVRfaGFvekY4dTY1bW5iTlFFekdqSFNkazViR19OZTd1ekxfanVuQQ))

Closing signal: Watch whether Zhihu or host platforms take down the gambling 'benefits' posts; if they remain, the community-dynamics feed is operating as a paid distribution channel for betting traffic.

冲突局势.zh:
中东冲突出现“口头降温、实际扩大”的复杂局面。特朗普取消对伊攻击导致油价跳水，但美沙联合打击伊拉克意味着美国主导的军事行动仍在纵深推进；美国将军承认兵力不足，令海湾盟友不安。同时，以色列定居者在西岸的暴力言论和袭击激起更大波澜，战争的经济成本与供应链风险持续累积。

- [特朗普叫停对伊攻击后油价大跌](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipwFBVV95cUxQYzJpcHpBNzFaOVcwdHg4SVJ4QkpmdXQtQTA2WDJrWWRHTXh5UVQ0OGNlYThoWm5tbUlkWnVacGlWY2ZtdWhucTNfLXo3TGk5WHltRktNcFNNWjNlSjRHbHVzNnVJaWhWWF9MQ3pLdUlBYy1ZU3ZlN19OV291ZnlsSnpicDFpS0FPZ0VVcGY4REJzQjdJQmtBa3VueEJsWVZ0NXVkS1gtaw)，但[美沙联合打击伊拉克](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiaEFVX3lxTFB4SUlTWVVFRE1nWE0yMGhFajNpRnpKZWR2c3U2eWpUT2ZZcjVuQ091YnJfMVNQVFlXSkV3V3ExRDdjanlRaG1FanB6N21pYTU1NmctV2NUYU5hZTZvV3QwbTN6TnMxTnlK)令“战争结束”叙事破产，中东战线反而多了一条。
- 美军将领[警告缺乏保卫以色列的兵力](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMirAFBVV95cUxNSU1KMWtvZXFmY3Z6dmw0bk9FLXVzRXZNXzZpeEU3ZGZzdmc2ZzQybWJ2eHFvbHJ0YTZrcDN6YzhaQW1XUkVOV2hHWGlZYS13SDZpNllYbTR1TnlRVDJSczVlWTE2ZFJYZlhNVkZyUTB1cVRIMVlkMTd5QlFIWXMxRzhpN2VzbHdnQU9qMzhabTh1eWNCVXY3dFg2T3lfOVpVQ0oyZUl4RnAxMVFv)，叠加特朗普要求美国人撤离的报道，海湾安全承诺面临信用危机。
- 以色列定居者公开宣扬“杀光”巴勒斯坦人，[西岸报复性袭击](https://news.google.)使约旦河西岸安全局势进一步恶化。
- 油价剧烈波动与化肥运输关键节点受扰，显示冲突正从军事向经济领域传导。

**收束判断**：中东战局仍处于“一边谈判、一边轰炸”的失控边缘，后续需警惕美国对伊朗政策反复带来的二次冲击。
冲突局势.en:
The conflict desk is dominated by the US-Iran-Iraq triangle and its spillovers into oil, the West Bank, and the Black Sea. The overall picture is not a single campaign but parallel fronts with different rules of escalation.

- **Iraq is becoming a second front.** [Joint US–Saudi attack on Iraq widens the front](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiaEFVX3lxTFB4SUlTWVVFRE1nWE0yMGhFajNpRnpKZWR2c3U2eWpUT2ZZcjVuQ091YnJfMVNQVFlXSkV3V3ExRDdjanlRaG1FanB6N21pYTU1NmctV2NUYU5hZTZvV3QwbTN6TnMxTnlK) of the wider Middle East war, according to WSWS; if confirmed, coalition strikes on Iraqi soil move the conflict beyond Iran and Yemen and risk mobilizing Iraqi militias.
- **Strike-reversal whiplash.** [Oil price tumbles as Trump cancels attack on Iran](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipwFBVV95cUxQYzJpcHpBNzFaOVcwdHg4SVJ4QkpmdXQtQTA2WDJrWWRHTXh5UVQ0OGNlYThoWm5tbUlkWnVacGlWY2ZtdWhucTNfLXo3TGk5WHltRktNcFNNWjNlSjRHbHVzNnVJaWhWWF9MQ3pLdUlBYy1ZU3ZlN19OV291ZnlsSnpicDFpS0FPZ0VVcGY4REJzQjdJQmtBa3VueEJsWVZ0NXVkS1gtaw) shows how quickly markets react to White House signals; the 'last barrel' politics of oil is now inseparable from escalation risk.
- **Ukraine is a bargaining chip question.** [Was Ukraine bargained into opening a new front in the US-Iran war?](https://news.google.) raises an unproven but persistent claim that Washington linked Ukraine support to opening pressure on Iran; monitor Turkish and regional media for further evidence.
- **West Bank violence is becoming more explicit.** [Israeli settler defends revenge attacks](https://news.google.) reflects a normalization of lethal settler violence that adds another combustible front.
- **Russia is protecting its Black Sea shipping lanes.** [Russia bolsters cargo ship protection](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMinwFBVV95cUxQUjNoX21Jd2R0N2x2aGtua2Vwa3pfX0RtYUx1Z1hCOVRJUTg1SlBhaUVjSWRlbmdkTGQ1WUF1TExaS2dqY2ZobmhJNk9WZHdfYzYyVWQwWGViRjlMZWFRanRhRXdaLUxYYW8yaThjbS1xZ3JfX3VudkFTR1ZpbU5xamY0MDJiQjNEV2k1c0ZlQ1dVT1ZjNjJqMVFFZ3FURGc) as it explores new routes, an acknowledgment that Ukrainian drone threats now reach far beyond the front line.

Closing signal: watch for Iraqi government protests or militia retaliation after the reported strikes, and whether the oil price drop proves temporary if Iran responds.

海军与印太.zh:
海上力量竞争聚焦“航道控制”与“高超音速水下威慑”。霍尔木兹海峡通行量降至冲突以来最低，胡塞武装威胁沙特油轮导致红海护航请求激增。俄中海军同步展示新型水下和反舰能力：俄罗斯“亚森-M”级核潜艇下水，中国052D驱逐舰被证实可发射YJ-20高超音速导弹。莱茵金属推出面向北美的新一代护卫舰方案，F-35B坠毁则暴露高频部署下的可靠性问题。

- [霍尔木兹海峡通行量连续下滑](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/31/hormuz-traffic-levels-continue-decreasing-houthis-in-yemen-threaten-saudi-tankers)，较前一周骤降52.4%，日均通航量进入个位数；[胡塞武装威胁沙特油轮](https://www.twz.com/news-features/red-sea-maritime-security-task-force-commander-talks-major-jump-in-escort-requests)，红海护航请求大幅上升。
- [俄亚森-M级核潜艇“乌里扬诺夫斯克”号浮出船坞](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/08/russia-floats-out-yasen-m-nuclear-submarine-ulyanovsk/)，进入舾装测试阶段，俄海军水下打击能力持续迭代。
- [中国海军052D驱逐舰发射YJ-20高超音速反舰导弹](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/31/chinese-navy-showcases-hypersonic-anti-ship-capability-aboard-destroyers)，意味着高超音速武器已大规模上舰，对西太平洋水面舰艇构成现实威胁。
- [莱茵金属GMF140护卫舰方案](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/08/rheinmetall-unveils-gmf140-frigate/)瞄准北美造舰市场，配备AEGIS和64单元垂发，显示欧洲防务商正打入美国主导的舰艇供应链。
- [F-35B在米拉马尔基地坠毁](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/31/breaking-f-35b-crashes-near-marine-corps-air-station-miramar)，飞行员成功弹射，该机队近期出动强度或面临重新评估。

**收束**：海上博弈正从航母与驱逐舰的“吨位竞赛”转向高超音速、水下威慑与航道控制的混合较量。
海军与印太.en:
Naval and Indo-Pacific reporting is split between Middle East chokepoint stress and a global naval-technology race. RIMPAC 2026 closed in Hawaii after 30-nation drills, [per USNI](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/31/usni-news-western-pacific-pulse-july-31-2026), even as new warship programs and first-time weapons firings elsewhere signaled a more distributed naval order.

- **Hormuz is still bleeding traffic.** [Hormuz traffic levels continue decreasing](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/31/hormuz-traffic-levels-continue-decreasing-houthis-in-yemen-threaten-saudi-tankers), with transits down 52.4% week-on-week and Houthis threatening Saudi tankers; this is a direct economic lever on global energy and fertilizer flows.
- **China is distributing hypersonic anti-ship missiles.** [Chinese Navy showcases hypersonic anti-ship capability aboard destroyers](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/31/chinese-navy-showcases-hypersonic-anti-ship-capability-aboard-destroyers): the YJ-20 was fired from a Type 052D, implying the capability is spreading from the Type 055 fleet to the most numerous class of PLA Navy destroyers.
- **Russia keeps producing modern submarines.** [Russia floats out Yasen-M-class nuclear submarine Ulyanovsk](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/08/russia-floats-out-yasen-m-nuclear-submarine-ulyanovsk/) on July 28, completing the hull phase; the Ulyanovsk will enter fitting-out and testing at Sevmash.
- **Western naval-industrial lines are moving.** [Rheinmetall’s GMF140](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/08/rheinmetall-unveils-gmf140-frigate/) targets US and Canadian frigate programs with AEGIS and 64 VLS cells, while [Australian HY80 steel is now destined for Virginia-class submarines](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/08/australian-steel-to-support-virginia-class-submarine-construction/), a concrete AUKUS integration step.
- **Japan is becoming a long-range strike player.** [Japan's first Tomahawk: JS Chōkai fires a cruise missile](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMif0FVX3lxTE5jS3RsZEtOUjZ6aWZWdXJwLTRIeE1OVy1hUFJvNU4wdjFLYmV1Y19Hekt3cVQ2OUxKSHJ6RWVPM1lJa2luZkYycjF5a0Q2TnliUVNTMUl4NzlWTmozRjQxX0xsT0JhZmdGZG9sSlBUcGswcElwajg2OENVeGl5LTg) converts an Aegis destroyer into an offensive strike platform and moves Tokyo closer to allied deterrence by denial.

Closing signal: watch for PLA live-fire notifications, the next Hormuz transit count, and whether Japan’s first Tomahawk firing shifts Chinese and Western Pacific patrol patterns.

国际安全.zh:
欧洲与印太盟友同步推进远程打击和太空作战能力。波兰成立太空司令部，法国为核武Rafale扩建基地；日本首次实射“战斧”导弹。同时，乌克兰空军公布惊人拦截数据，说明俄军无人机和导弹打击规模持续高涨。美国海军则寻求新型潜射防空导弹，以应对空中威胁多样化。

- [波兰成立太空司令部](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiwwFBVV95cUxPc0ZWWHJKVFhSNWF5VDZTMkYtTGYwbTVNb2Y2OW5Gbk5sZ3ppUWdlYl85al80cFUtbmxGMVY1bENfdGN5bExSU2M4RXkyWVBVeVZNWk8xalBJbFFFMjlvRjlPdk94Y0kxc3otRlQ1N044ZmpJNDZZU3JGU3ptWXpVbDhHcUpxbEswNUx1OXFZMGNiLVBpUTFjWTlSaE1pNmlNdzkxMzBfZ0dtS201cnA4dlBfTWRxQ0l4SW9EVm83YllpWkE)，并强调“卫星需要作战权限”，标志着太空正式纳入欧洲国家作战指挥链条。
- [法国准备新基地部署扩大后的核武Rafale机队](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMigwFBVV95cUxOaGJGTE54OTU1TXhwejZMaEhZVkFHTVdRc2s2VUpRbjE5QmJrbjV1UGc0WGNRdkRuM0t2bEZUaEdhWmlVUGpnTHJiMW5GYnpYSjNGMFl5SkJMV3ZBMjVoa1pQcTZZQkdVVkpwTmx2b3dnUnRWRnRVSW1Eck1WNFdSZmhRRQ)，核威慑力量在欧陆安全框架中的权重上升。
- [日本“羽黑”号驱逐舰首次发射“战斧”](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMif0FVX3lxTE5jS3RsZEtOUjZ6aWZWdXJwLTRIeE1OVy1hUFJvNU4wdjFLYmV1Y19Hekt3cVQ2OUxKSHJ6RWVPM1lJa2luZkYycjF5a0Q2TnliUVNTMUl4NzlWTmozRjQxX0xsT0JhZmdGZG9sSlBUcGswcElwajg2OENVeGl5LTg)，日本获得防区外纵深打击能力，对地区战略平衡产生实质影响。
- 乌克兰空军在空军节披露，累计[击落91枚“匕首”和65,000多架“沙赫德”](https://news.google.)，这一数字本身也说明俄军消耗战规模之大。
- 美国海军正式寻求[潜射型防空导弹](https://www.twz.com/sea/u-s-navy-is-seeking-a-submarine-launched-anti-air-missile)，将“潜艇+防空”组合纳入未来分布式作战设想，重新定义水下平台的任务边界。

**收束**：各国正将远程精确打击、太空与水下战力整合进各自战略工具箱，军备竞赛的“技术奇点”越来越近。
国际安全.en:
The international security desk shows the US military is overstretched tactically and searching for new capabilities, while Europe is building independent deterrence infrastructure. The most consequential development is not a single deployment but the widening gap between US commitments and available forces.
